    | categoryRefl => categoryRefl

-- Second functor over shared category instances.
def Second_Functor : (0 C : Sort (succ w)) -> (0 D : Sort (succ p)) ->
    Middle_Category C -> Target_Category D -> Sort (max (max (succ w) (succ z)) (max (succ p) (succ q))) :=
  fun (0 C : Sort (succ w)) (0 D : Sort (succ p))
      (c : Middle_Category C) (d : Target_Category D) =>
    (obj : C -> D) *
    (map : (0 x : C) -> (0 y : C) -> Middle_Hom C c x y -> Target_Hom D d (obj x) (obj y)) *
    (mapId : (0 x : C) -> Target (Target_Hom D d (obj x) (obj x))
      (map x x (Middle_id C c x)) (Target_id D d (obj x))) *
    ((0 x : C) -> (0 y : C) -> (0 z : C) ->
      (0 f : Middle_Hom C c x y) -> (0 g : Middle_Hom C c y z) ->
      Target (Target_Hom D d (obj x) (obj z))
        (map x z (Middle_comp C c x y z f g))
        (Target_comp D d (obj x) (obj y) (obj z) (map x y f) (map y z g)))

def Second_functorObj : (0 C : Sort (succ w)) -> (0 D : Sort (succ p)) ->
    (c : Middle_Category C) -> (d : Target_Category D) -> Second_Functor C D c d -> C -> D :=
  fun (0 C : Sort (succ w)) (0 D : Sort (succ p))
      (c : Middle_Category C) (d : Target_Category D) (F : Second_Functor C D c d) => F.1

def Second_functorMap : (0 C : Sort (succ w)) -> (0 D : Sort (succ p)) ->
    (c : Middle_Category C) -> (d : Target_Category D) -> (F : Second_Functor C D c d) ->
    (0 x : C) -> (0 y : C) -> Middle_Hom C c x y ->
    Target_Hom D d (Second_functorObj C D c d F x) (Second_functorObj C D c d F y) :=
  fun (0 C : Sort (succ w)) (0 D : Sort (succ p))
      (c : Middle_Category C) (d : Target_Category D) (F : Second_Functor C D c d) => F.2.1

def Second_functorMapId : (0 C : Sort (succ w)) -> (0 D : Sort (succ p)) ->
    (c : Middle_Category C) -> (d : Target_Category D) -> (F : Second_Functor C D c d) ->
    (0 x : C) -> Target (Target_Hom D d (F.1 x) (F.1 x))
      (Second_functorMap C D c d F x x (Middle_id C c x)) (Target_id D d (F.1 x)) :=
  fun (0 C : Sort (succ w)) (0 D : Sort (succ p))

def compFunctor : (0 C : Sort (succ u)) -> (0 D : Sort (succ w)) ->
    (0 E : Sort (succ p)) -> (c : Source_Category C) -> (d : Middle_Category D) ->
    (e : Target_Category E) -> First_Functor C D c d -> Second_Functor D E d e -> Composite_Functor C E c e :=
  fun (0 C : Sort (succ u)) (0 D : Sort (succ w)) (0 E : Sort (succ p))
      (c : Source_Category C) (d : Middle_Category D) (e : Target_Category E)
      (F : First_Functor C D c d) (G : Second_Functor D E d e) =>
    ((fun (x : C) => G.1 (F.1 x)),
     ((fun (0 x : C) (0 y : C) (f : Source_Hom C c x y) =>
         Second_functorMap D E d e G (F.1 x) (F.1 y) (First_functorMap C D c d F x y f)),
      ((fun (0 x : C) =>
          Target_eqTrans (Target_Hom E e (G.1 (F.1 x)) (G.1 (F.1 x)))
            (Second_functorMap D E d e G (F.1 x) (F.1 x)
              (First_functorMap C D c d F x x (Source_id C c x)))
            (Second_functorMap D E d e G (F.1 x) (F.1 x) (Middle_id D d (F.1 x)))
            (Target_id E e (G.1 (F.1 x)))
            (Second_eqCongr (Middle_Hom D d (F.1 x) (F.1 x))
              (Target_Hom E e (G.1 (F.1 x)) (G.1 (F.1 x)))
              (fun (h : Middle_Hom D d (F.1 x) (F.1 x)) =>
                Second_functorMap D E d e G (F.1 x) (F.1 x) h)
              (First_functorMap C D c d F x x (Source_id C c x)) (Middle_id D d (F.1 x))
              (First_functorMapId C D c d F x))
            (Second_functorMapId D E d e G (F.1 x))),
       (fun (0 x : C) (0 y : C) (0 z : C)
            (0 f : Source_Hom C c x y) (0 g : Source_Hom C c y z) =>
          Target_eqTrans (Target_Hom E e (G.1 (F.1 x)) (G.1 (F.1 z)))
            (Second_functorMap D E d e G (F.1 x) (F.1 z)
              (First_functorMap C D c d F x z (Source_comp C c x y z f g)))
            (Second_functorMap D E d e G (F.1 x) (F.1 z)
              (Middle_comp D d (F.1 x) (F.1 y) (F.1 z)
                (First_functorMap C D c d F x y f) (First_functorMap C D c d F y z g)))
            (Target_comp E e (G.1 (F.1 x)) (G.1 (F.1 y)) (G.1 (F.1 z))
              (Second_functorMap D E d e G (F.1 x) (F.1 y) (First_functorMap C D c d F x y f))
              (Second_functorMap D E d e G (F.1 y) (F.1 z) (First_functorMap C D c d F y z g)))
            (Second_eqCongr (Middle_Hom D d (F.1 x) (F.1 z))
              (Target_Hom E e (G.1 (F.1 x)) (G.1 (F.1 z)))
              (fun (h : Middle_Hom D d (F.1 x) (F.1 z)) =>
                Second_functorMap D E d e G (F.1 x) (F.1 z) h)
              (First_functorMap C D c d F x z (Source_comp C c x y z f g))
              (Middle_comp D d (F.1 x) (F.1 y) (F.1 z)
                (First_functorMap C D c d F x y f) (First_functorMap C D c d F y z g))
              (First_functorMapComp C D c d F x y z f g))
            (Second_functorMapComp D E d e G (F.1 x) (F.1 y) (F.1 z)
              (First_functorMap C D c d F x y f) (First_functorMap C D c d F y z g))))))

             (Base_Middle_comp D d (F.1 x) (F.1 y) (G.1 y)
               (Base_First_functorMap C D c d F x y f) (alpha.1 y))

               (alpha.1 x) (Base_First_functorMap C D c d G x y f))

             (alpha.1 x) (Base_First_functorMap C D c d G x y f)))))
end

-- Checked data at the first data universe.  No declaration uses the
-- driver's initial Nat axiom or its literal primitives.

mu MechNat : Type 0 with
| mechZero : MechNat
| mechSucc : MechNat -> MechNat

mu MechBool : Type 0 with
| mechFalse : MechBool
| mechTrue : MechBool

mu MechUnit : Type 0 with
| mechUnit : MechUnit

mu MechEmpty : Type 0 with

mu MechFalse : Prop with

mu MechTrue : Prop with
| mechTrivial : MechTrue

mu MechSum (0 A : Type 0) (0 B : Type 0) : Type 0 with
| mechInl : A -> MechSum A B
| mechInr : B -> MechSum A B

mu MechDecidable (0 P : Prop) : Type 0 with
| mechIsFalse : (0 refute : P -> MechFalse) -> MechDecidable P
| mechIsTrue : (0 proof : P) -> MechDecidable P

def MechPi : (0 A : Type 0) -> (0 B : A -> Type 0) -> Type 0 :=
  fun (0 A : Type 0) (0 B : A -> Type 0) => (x : A) -> B x

def MechSigma : (0 A : Type 0) -> (0 B : A -> Type 0) -> Type 0 :=
  fun (0 A : Type 0) (0 B : A -> Type 0) => (x : A) * B x

def mechBoolRec : (0 A : Type 0) -> A -> A -> MechBool -> A :=
  fun (0 A : Type 0) (no : A) (yes : A) (b : MechBool) =>
    case b as self in MechBool return A with
    | mechFalse => no
    | mechTrue => yes

def mechEmptyElim : (0 A : Type 0) -> MechEmpty -> A :=
  fun (0 A : Type 0) (e : MechEmpty) =>
    case e as self in MechEmpty return A with

def mechFalseElim : (0 A : Type 0) -> MechFalse -> A :=
  fun (0 A : Type 0) (e : MechFalse) =>
    case e as self in MechFalse return A with

def mechSumRec : (0 A : Type 0) -> (0 B : Type 0) ->
    (0 C : Type 0) -> (A -> C) -> (B -> C) -> MechSum A B -> C :=
  fun (0 A : Type 0) (0 B : Type 0) (0 C : Type 0)
    (left : A -> C) (right : B -> C) (s : MechSum A B) =>
      case s as self in MechSum return C with
      | mechInl a => left a
      | mechInr b => right b

def rec mechNatRec : (0 P : MechNat -> Type 0) -> P mechZero ->
    ((n : MechNat) -> P n -> P (mechSucc n)) -> (n : MechNat) -> P n :=
  fun (0 P : MechNat -> Type 0) (zero : P mechZero)
    (step : (n : MechNat) -> P n -> P (mechSucc n)) (n : MechNat) =>
      case n as self in MechNat return P self with
      | mechZero => zero
      | mechSucc previous => step previous (mechNatRec P zero step previous)

def mechDecidableBool : (0 P : Prop) -> MechDecidable P -> MechBool :=
  fun (0 P : Prop) (d : MechDecidable P) =>
    case d as self in MechDecidable return MechBool with
    | mechIsFalse 0 refute => mechFalse
    | mechIsTrue 0 proof => mechTrue

-- Equality keeps its endpoints erased and carries no constructor field.
-- The singleton criterion therefore admits elimination into data.
mu MechEq (0 A : Type 0) (0 x : A) : (0 y : A) -> Prop with
| mechReflCtor : MechEq A x x

def mechRefl : (0 A : Type 0) -> (0 x : A) -> MechEq A x x :=
  fun (0 A : Type 0) (0 x : A) => mechReflCtor

def mechJ : (0 A : Type 0) -> (0 x : A) ->
    (0 P : (0 y : A) -> (0 e : MechEq A x y) -> Type 0) ->
    P x (mechRefl A x) -> (0 y : A) -> (e : MechEq A x y) -> P y e :=
  fun (0 A : Type 0) (0 x : A)
    (0 P : (0 y : A) -> (0 e : MechEq A x y) -> Type 0)
    (reflCase : P x (mechRefl A x)) (0 y : A) (e : MechEq A x y) =>
      case e as self in MechEq right return P right self with
      | mechReflCtor => reflCase

def mechTransport : (0 A : Type 0) -> (0 B : A -> Type 0) ->
    (0 x : A) -> (0 y : A) -> MechEq A x y -> B x -> B y :=
  fun (0 A : Type 0) (0 B : A -> Type 0)
    (0 x : A) (0 y : A) (e : MechEq A x y) (value : B x) =>
      mechJ A x (fun (0 right : A) (0 proof : MechEq A x right) => B right)
        value y e

def mechSymm : (0 A : Type 0) -> (0 x : A) -> (0 y : A) ->
    MechEq A x y -> MechEq A y x :=
  fun (0 A : Type 0) (0 x : A) (0 y : A) (e : MechEq A x y) =>
    case e as self in MechEq right return MechEq A right x with
    | mechReflCtor => mechRefl A x

def mechTrans : (0 A : Type 0) -> (0 x : A) -> (0 y : A) -> (0 z : A) ->
    MechEq A x y -> MechEq A y z -> MechEq A x z :=
  fun (0 A : Type 0) (0 x : A) (0 y : A) (0 z : A)
    (first : MechEq A x y) (second : MechEq A y z) =>
      case second as self in MechEq right return MechEq A x right with
      | mechReflCtor => first

def mechCongr : (0 A : Type 0) -> (0 B : Type 0) -> (0 f : A -> B) ->
    (0 x : A) -> (0 y : A) -> MechEq A x y -> MechEq B (f x) (f y) :=
  fun (0 A : Type 0) (0 B : Type 0) (0 f : A -> B)
    (0 x : A) (0 y : A) (e : MechEq A x y) =>
      case e as self in MechEq right return MechEq B (f x) (f right) with
      | mechReflCtor => mechRefl B (f x)

-- The older proof equality has a relevant constructor witness, so it
-- remains an example whose elimination into data is rejected.
mu MechProofEq (0 A : Prop) : (0 x : A) -> (0 y : A) -> Prop with
| mechProofReflCtor : (x : A) -> MechProofEq A x x

def mechProofRefl : (0 A : Prop) -> (x : A) -> MechProofEq A x x :=
  fun (0 A : Prop) (x : A) => mechProofReflCtor x

def mechProofJ : (0 A : Prop) ->
    (0 P : (0 x : A) -> (0 y : A) -> (0 e : MechProofEq A x y) -> Prop) ->
    ((x : A) -> P x x (mechProofRefl A x)) ->
    (0 x : A) -> (0 y : A) -> (e : MechProofEq A x y) -> P x y e :=
  fun (0 A : Prop)
    (0 P : (0 x : A) -> (0 y : A) -> (0 e : MechProofEq A x y) -> Prop)
    (reflCase : (x : A) -> P x x (mechProofRefl A x))
    (0 x : A) (0 y : A) (e : MechProofEq A x y) =>
      case e as self in MechProofEq left right return P left right self with
      | mechProofReflCtor witness => reflCase witness

-- Categories have independent object and morphism Type levels.
-- The equality family and all members specialize together.
poly (u, v) mu MechCategory (0 A : Sort (succ v)) (0 x : A) :
    (0 y : A) -> Prop with
| categoryRefl : MechCategory A x x
where
def Category : (0 Obj : Sort (succ u)) -> Sort (max (succ u) (succ (succ v))) :=
  fun (0 Obj : Sort (succ u)) =>
    (hom : (0 x : Obj) -> (0 y : Obj) -> Sort (succ v)) *
    (identity : (0 x : Obj) -> hom x x) *
    (compose : (0 x : Obj) -> (0 y : Obj) -> (0 z : Obj) ->
      hom x y -> hom y z -> hom x z) *
    (left : (0 x : Obj) -> (0 y : Obj) -> (0 f : hom x y) ->
      MechCategory (hom x y) (compose x x y (identity x) f) f) *
    (right : (0 x : Obj) -> (0 y : Obj) -> (0 f : hom x y) ->
      MechCategory (hom x y) (compose x y y f (identity y)) f) *
    ((0 w : Obj) -> (0 x : Obj) -> (0 y : Obj) -> (0 z : Obj) ->
      (0 f : hom w x) -> (0 g : hom x y) -> (0 h : hom y z) ->
      MechCategory (hom w z)
        (compose w y z (compose w x y f g) h)
        (compose w x z f (compose x y z g h)))

def Hom : (0 Obj : Sort (succ u)) -> (category : Category Obj) ->
    (0 x : Obj) -> (0 y : Obj) -> Sort (succ v) :=
  fun (0 Obj : Sort (succ u)) (category : Category Obj) => category.1

def id : (0 Obj : Sort (succ u)) -> (category : Category Obj) ->
    (0 x : Obj) -> Hom Obj category x x :=
  fun (0 Obj : Sort (succ u)) (category : Category Obj) => category.2.1

def comp : (0 Obj : Sort (succ u)) -> (category : Category Obj) ->
    (0 x : Obj) -> (0 y : Obj) -> (0 z : Obj) ->
    Hom Obj category x y -> Hom Obj category y z -> Hom Obj category x z :=
  fun (0 Obj : Sort (succ u)) (category : Category Obj) => category.2.2.1

def idComp : (0 Obj : Sort (succ u)) -> (category : Category Obj) ->
    (0 x : Obj) -> (0 y : Obj) -> (0 f : Hom Obj category x y) ->
    MechCategory (Hom Obj category x y) (comp Obj category x x y (id Obj category x) f) f :=
  fun (0 Obj : Sort (succ u)) (category : Category Obj) => category.2.2.2.1

def compId : (0 Obj : Sort (succ u)) -> (category : Category Obj) ->
    (0 x : Obj) -> (0 y : Obj) -> (0 f : Hom Obj category x y) ->
    MechCategory (Hom Obj category x y) (comp Obj category x y y f (id Obj category y)) f :=
  fun (0 Obj : Sort (succ u)) (category : Category Obj) => category.2.2.2.2.1

def assoc : (0 Obj : Sort (succ u)) -> (category : Category Obj) ->
    (0 w : Obj) -> (0 x : Obj) -> (0 y : Obj) -> (0 z : Obj) ->
    (0 f : Hom Obj category w x) -> (0 g : Hom Obj category x y) ->
    (0 h : Hom Obj category y z) ->
    MechCategory (Hom Obj category w z)
      (comp Obj category w y z (comp Obj category w x y f g) h)
      (comp Obj category w x z f (comp Obj category x y z g h)) :=
  fun (0 Obj : Sort (succ u)) (category : Category Obj) => category.2.2.2.2.2

-- Equality operations retain this group's nominal equality family.
def eqTrans : (0 A : Sort (succ v)) -> (0 x : A) -> (0 y : A) ->
    (0 z : A) -> MechCategory A x y -> MechCategory A y z -> MechCategory A x z :=
  fun (0 A : Sort (succ v)) (0 x : A) (0 y : A) (0 z : A)
      (first : MechCategory A x y) (second : MechCategory A y z) =>
    match second as self in MechCategory right return MechCategory A x right with
    | categoryRefl => first

def eqCongr : (0 A : Sort (succ v)) -> (0 B : Sort (succ v)) ->
    (0 f : A -> B) -> (0 x : A) -> (0 y : A) ->
    MechCategory A x y -> MechCategory B (f x) (f y) :=
  fun (0 A : Sort (succ v)) (0 B : Sort (succ v)) (0 f : A -> B)
      (0 x : A) (0 y : A) (proof : MechCategory A x y) =>
    match proof as self in MechCategory right return MechCategory B (f x) (f right) with
    | categoryRefl => categoryRefl

-- Both categories use the group's levels and equality family.
def Functor : (0 C : Sort (succ u)) -> (0 D : Sort (succ u)) ->
    Category C -> Category D -> Sort (max (succ u) (succ v)) :=
  fun (0 C : Sort (succ u)) (0 D : Sort (succ u))
      (c : Category C) (d : Category D) =>
    (obj : C -> D) *
    (map : (0 x : C) -> (0 y : C) -> Hom C c x y -> Hom D d (obj x) (obj y)) *
    (mapId : (0 x : C) -> MechCategory (Hom D d (obj x) (obj x))
      (map x x (id C c x)) (id D d (obj x))) *
    ((0 x : C) -> (0 y : C) -> (0 z : C) ->
      (0 f : Hom C c x y) -> (0 g : Hom C c y z) ->
      MechCategory (Hom D d (obj x) (obj z))
        (map x z (comp C c x y z f g))
        (comp D d (obj x) (obj y) (obj z) (map x y f) (map y z g)))

def functorObj : (0 C : Sort (succ u)) -> (0 D : Sort (succ u)) ->
    (c : Category C) -> (d : Category D) -> Functor C D c d -> C -> D :=
  fun (0 C : Sort (succ u)) (0 D : Sort (succ u))
      (c : Category C) (d : Category D) (F : Functor C D c d) => F.1

def functorMap : (0 C : Sort (succ u)) -> (0 D : Sort (succ u)) ->
    (c : Category C) -> (d : Category D) -> (F : Functor C D c d) ->
    (0 x : C) -> (0 y : C) -> Hom C c x y ->
    Hom D d (functorObj C D c d F x) (functorObj C D c d F y) :=
  fun (0 C : Sort (succ u)) (0 D : Sort (succ u))
      (c : Category C) (d : Category D) (F : Functor C D c d) => F.2.1

def functorMapId : (0 C : Sort (succ u)) -> (0 D : Sort (succ u)) ->
    (c : Category C) -> (d : Category D) -> (F : Functor C D c d) ->
    (0 x : C) -> MechCategory (Hom D d (F.1 x) (F.1 x))
      (functorMap C D c d F x x (id C c x)) (id D d (F.1 x)) :=
  fun (0 C : Sort (succ u)) (0 D : Sort (succ u))
      (c : Category C) (d : Category D) (F : Functor C D c d) => F.2.2.1

def functorMapComp : (0 C : Sort (succ u)) -> (0 D : Sort (succ u)) ->
    (c : Category C) -> (d : Category D) -> (F : Functor C D c d) ->
    (0 x : C) -> (0 y : C) -> (0 z : C) ->
    (0 f : Hom C c x y) -> (0 g : Hom C c y z) ->
    MechCategory (Hom D d (F.1 x) (F.1 z))
      (functorMap C D c d F x z (comp C c x y z f g))
      (comp D d (F.1 x) (F.1 y) (F.1 z)
        (functorMap C D c d F x y f) (functorMap C D c d F y z g)) :=
  fun (0 C : Sort (succ u)) (0 D : Sort (succ u))
      (c : Category C) (d : Category D) (F : Functor C D c d) => F.2.2.2

def idFunctor : (0 C : Sort (succ u)) -> (c : Category C) -> Functor C C c c :=
  fun (0 C : Sort (succ u)) (c : Category C) =>
    ((fun (x : C) => x),
     ((fun (0 x : C) (0 y : C) (f : Hom C c x y) => f),
      ((fun (0 x : C) => categoryRefl),
       (fun (0 x : C) (0 y : C) (0 z : C)
            (0 f : Hom C c x y) (0 g : Hom C c y z) => categoryRefl))))

def compFunctor : (0 C : Sort (succ u)) -> (0 D : Sort (succ u)) ->
    (0 E : Sort (succ u)) -> (c : Category C) -> (d : Category D) ->
    (e : Category E) -> Functor C D c d -> Functor D E d e -> Functor C E c e :=
  fun (0 C : Sort (succ u)) (0 D : Sort (succ u)) (0 E : Sort (succ u))
      (c : Category C) (d : Category D) (e : Category E)
      (F : Functor C D c d) (G : Functor D E d e) =>
    ((fun (x : C) => G.1 (F.1 x)),
     ((fun (0 x : C) (0 y : C) (f : Hom C c x y) =>
         functorMap D E d e G (F.1 x) (F.1 y) (functorMap C D c d F x y f)),
      ((fun (0 x : C) =>
          eqTrans (Hom E e (G.1 (F.1 x)) (G.1 (F.1 x)))
            (functorMap D E d e G (F.1 x) (F.1 x)
              (functorMap C D c d F x x (id C c x)))
            (functorMap D E d e G (F.1 x) (F.1 x) (id D d (F.1 x)))
            (id E e (G.1 (F.1 x)))
            (eqCongr (Hom D d (F.1 x) (F.1 x))
              (Hom E e (G.1 (F.1 x)) (G.1 (F.1 x)))
              (fun (h : Hom D d (F.1 x) (F.1 x)) =>
                functorMap D E d e G (F.1 x) (F.1 x) h)
              (functorMap C D c d F x x (id C c x)) (id D d (F.1 x))
              (functorMapId C D c d F x))
            (functorMapId D E d e G (F.1 x))),
       (fun (0 x : C) (0 y : C) (0 z : C)
            (0 f : Hom C c x y) (0 g : Hom C c y z) =>
          eqTrans (Hom E e (G.1 (F.1 x)) (G.1 (F.1 z)))
            (functorMap D E d e G (F.1 x) (F.1 z)
              (functorMap C D c d F x z (comp C c x y z f g)))
            (functorMap D E d e G (F.1 x) (F.1 z)
              (comp D d (F.1 x) (F.1 y) (F.1 z)
                (functorMap C D c d F x y f) (functorMap C D c d F y z g)))
            (comp E e (G.1 (F.1 x)) (G.1 (F.1 y)) (G.1 (F.1 z))
              (functorMap D E d e G (F.1 x) (F.1 y) (functorMap C D c d F x y f))
              (functorMap D E d e G (F.1 y) (F.1 z) (functorMap C D c d F y z g)))
            (eqCongr (Hom D d (F.1 x) (F.1 z))
              (Hom E e (G.1 (F.1 x)) (G.1 (F.1 z)))
              (fun (h : Hom D d (F.1 x) (F.1 z)) =>
                functorMap D E d e G (F.1 x) (F.1 z) h)
              (functorMap C D c d F x z (comp C c x y z f g))
              (comp D d (F.1 x) (F.1 y) (F.1 z)
                (functorMap C D c d F x y f) (functorMap C D c d F y z g))
              (functorMapComp C D c d F x y z f g))
            (functorMapComp D E d e G (F.1 x) (F.1 y) (F.1 z)
              (functorMap C D c d F x y f) (functorMap C D c d F y z g))))))

def eqSymm : (0 A : Sort (succ v)) -> (0 x : A) -> (0 y : A) ->
    MechCategory A x y -> MechCategory A y x :=
  fun (0 A : Sort (succ v)) (0 x : A) (0 y : A)
      (proof : MechCategory A x y) =>
    match proof as self in MechCategory right return MechCategory A right x with
    | categoryRefl => categoryRefl

-- Components can inspect their object.  The naturality field erases.
-- A naturality proof can inspect its morphism during proof construction.
def NatTrans : (0 C : Sort (succ u)) -> (0 D : Sort (succ u)) ->
    (c : Category C) -> (d : Category D) ->
    Functor C D c d -> Functor C D c d -> Sort (max (succ u) (succ v)) :=
  fun (0 C : Sort (succ u)) (0 D : Sort (succ u))
      (c : Category C) (d : Category D)
      (F : Functor C D c d) (G : Functor C D c d) =>
    (app : (x : C) -> Hom D d (F.1 x) (G.1 x)) *
    ((0 x : C) -> (0 y : C) -> (f : Hom C c x y) ->
      MechCategory (Hom D d (F.1 x) (G.1 y))
        (comp D d (F.1 x) (F.1 y) (G.1 y)
          (functorMap C D c d F x y f) (app y))
        (comp D d (F.1 x) (G.1 x) (G.1 y)
          (app x) (functorMap C D c d G x y f)))

def natApp : (0 C : Sort (succ u)) -> (0 D : Sort (succ u)) ->
    (c : Category C) -> (d : Category D) ->
    (F : Functor C D c d) -> (G : Functor C D c d) ->
    NatTrans C D c d F G -> (x : C) -> Hom D d (F.1 x) (G.1 x) :=
  fun (0 C : Sort (succ u)) (0 D : Sort (succ u))
      (c : Category C) (d : Category D)
      (F : Functor C D c d) (G : Functor C D c d)
      (alpha : NatTrans C D c d F G) => alpha.1

def naturality : (0 C : Sort (succ u)) -> (0 D : Sort (succ u)) ->
    (c : Category C) -> (d : Category D) ->
    (F : Functor C D c d) -> (G : Functor C D c d) ->
    (alpha : NatTrans C D c d F G) ->
    (0 x : C) -> (0 y : C) -> (f : Hom C c x y) ->
    MechCategory (Hom D d (F.1 x) (G.1 y))
      (comp D d (F.1 x) (F.1 y) (G.1 y)
        (functorMap C D c d F x y f) (alpha.1 y))
      (comp D d (F.1 x) (G.1 x) (G.1 y)
        (alpha.1 x) (functorMap C D c d G x y f)) :=
  fun (0 C : Sort (succ u)) (0 D : Sort (succ u))
      (c : Category C) (d : Category D)
      (F : Functor C D c d) (G : Functor C D c d)
      (alpha : NatTrans C D c d F G) => alpha.2

def idNat : (0 C : Sort (succ u)) -> (0 D : Sort (succ u)) ->
    (c : Category C) -> (d : Category D) ->
    (F : Functor C D c d) -> NatTrans C D c d F F :=
  fun (0 C : Sort (succ u)) (0 D : Sort (succ u))
      (c : Category C) (d : Category D) (F : Functor C D c d) =>
    ((fun (x : C) => id D d (F.1 x)),
     (fun (0 x : C) (0 y : C) (f : Hom C c x y) =>
       eqTrans (Hom D d (F.1 x) (F.1 y))
       (comp D d (F.1 x) (F.1 y) (F.1 y) (functorMap C D c d F x y f) (id D d (F.1 y)))
       (functorMap C D c d F x y f)
       (comp D d (F.1 x) (F.1 x) (F.1 y) (id D d (F.1 x)) (functorMap C D c d F x y f))
       (compId D d (F.1 x) (F.1 y) (functorMap C D c d F x y f))
       (eqSymm (Hom D d (F.1 x) (F.1 y))
       (comp D d (F.1 x) (F.1 x) (F.1 y) (id D d (F.1 x)) (functorMap C D c d F x y f))
       (functorMap C D c d F x y f) (idComp D d (F.1 x) (F.1 y) (functorMap C D c d F x y f)))))

-- Two naturality squares compose using the category laws.
def vcompLaw : (0 D : Sort (succ u)) -> (d : Category D) ->
    (0 fx : D) -> (0 fy : D) -> (0 gx : D) -> (0 gy : D) -> (0 hx : D) -> (0 hy : D) ->
    (0 fm : Hom D d fx fy) -> (0 gm : Hom D d gx gy) -> (0 hm : Hom D d hx hy) ->
    (0 ax : Hom D d fx gx) -> (0 ay : Hom D d fy gy) ->
    (0 bx : Hom D d gx hx) -> (0 by : Hom D d gy hy) ->
    MechCategory (Hom D d fx gy) (comp D d fx fy gy fm ay) (comp D d fx gx gy ax gm) ->
    MechCategory (Hom D d gx hy) (comp D d gx gy hy gm by) (comp D d gx hx hy bx hm) ->
    MechCategory (Hom D d fx hy)
      (comp D d fx fy hy fm (comp D d fy gy hy ay by))
      (comp D d fx hx hy (comp D d fx gx hx ax bx) hm) :=
  fun (0 D : Sort (succ u)) (d : Category D)
      (0 fx : D) (0 fy : D) (0 gx : D) (0 gy : D) (0 hx : D) (0 hy : D)
      (0 fm : Hom D d fx fy) (0 gm : Hom D d gx gy) (0 hm : Hom D d hx hy)
      (0 ax : Hom D d fx gx) (0 ay : Hom D d fy gy)
      (0 bx : Hom D d gx hx) (0 by : Hom D d gy hy)
      (first : MechCategory (Hom D d fx gy)
        (comp D d fx fy gy fm ay) (comp D d fx gx gy ax gm))
      (second : MechCategory (Hom D d gx hy)
        (comp D d gx gy hy gm by) (comp D d gx hx hy bx hm)) =>
    eqTrans (Hom D d fx hy)
      (comp D d fx fy hy fm (comp D d fy gy hy ay by))
      (comp D d fx gy hy (comp D d fx fy gy fm ay) by)
      (comp D d fx hx hy (comp D d fx gx hx ax bx) hm)
      (eqSymm (Hom D d fx hy)
        (comp D d fx gy hy (comp D d fx fy gy fm ay) by)
        (comp D d fx fy hy fm (comp D d fy gy hy ay by))
        (assoc D d fx fy gy hy fm ay by))
      (eqTrans (Hom D d fx hy)
        (comp D d fx gy hy (comp D d fx fy gy fm ay) by)
        (comp D d fx gy hy (comp D d fx gx gy ax gm) by)
        (comp D d fx hx hy (comp D d fx gx hx ax bx) hm)
        (eqCongr (Hom D d fx gy) (Hom D d fx hy)
          (fun (h : Hom D d fx gy) => comp D d fx gy hy h by)
          (comp D d fx fy gy fm ay) (comp D d fx gx gy ax gm) first)
        (eqTrans (Hom D d fx hy)
          (comp D d fx gy hy (comp D d fx gx gy ax gm) by)
          (comp D d fx gx hy ax (comp D d gx gy hy gm by))
          (comp D d fx hx hy (comp D d fx gx hx ax bx) hm)
          (assoc D d fx gx gy hy ax gm by)
          (eqTrans (Hom D d fx hy)
            (comp D d fx gx hy ax (comp D d gx gy hy gm by))
            (comp D d fx gx hy ax (comp D d gx hx hy bx hm))
            (comp D d fx hx hy (comp D d fx gx hx ax bx) hm)
            (eqCongr (Hom D d gx hy) (Hom D d fx hy)
              (fun (h : Hom D d gx hy) => comp D d fx gx hy ax h)
              (comp D d gx gy hy gm by) (comp D d gx hx hy bx hm) second)
            (eqSymm (Hom D d fx hy)
              (comp D d fx hx hy (comp D d fx gx hx ax bx) hm)
              (comp D d fx gx hy ax (comp D d gx hx hy bx hm))
              (assoc D d fx gx hx hy ax bx hm)))))

-- Vertical composition applies alpha first, then beta.
def vcomp : (0 C : Sort (succ u)) -> (0 D : Sort (succ u)) ->
    (c : Category C) -> (d : Category D) ->
    (F : Functor C D c d) -> (G : Functor C D c d) ->
    (H : Functor C D c d) -> NatTrans C D c d F G ->
    NatTrans C D c d G H -> NatTrans C D c d F H :=
  fun (0 C : Sort (succ u)) (0 D : Sort (succ u))
      (c : Category C) (d : Category D)
      (F : Functor C D c d) (G : Functor C D c d) (H : Functor C D c d)
      (alpha : NatTrans C D c d F G) (beta : NatTrans C D c d G H) =>
    ((fun (x : C) =>
       comp D d (F.1 x) (G.1 x) (H.1 x) (alpha.1 x) (beta.1 x)),
     (fun (0 x : C) (0 y : C) (f : Hom C c x y) =>
       vcompLaw D d (F.1 x) (F.1 y) (G.1 x) (G.1 y) (H.1 x) (H.1 y)
         (functorMap C D c d F x y f) (functorMap C D c d G x y f)
         (functorMap C D c d H x y f) (alpha.1 x) (alpha.1 y) (beta.1 x) (beta.1 y)
         (naturality C D c d F G alpha x y f) (naturality C D c d G H beta x y f)))

-- UAT calls precomposition whiskerRight: evaluate alpha at K's object.
def whiskerRight : (0 C : Sort (succ u)) -> (0 D : Sort (succ u)) ->
    (0 E : Sort (succ u)) -> (c : Category C) -> (d : Category D) ->
    (e : Category E) -> (F : Functor C D c d) -> (G : Functor C D c d) ->
    NatTrans C D c d F G -> (K : Functor E C e c) ->
    (app : (x : E) -> Hom D d (F.1 (K.1 x)) (G.1 (K.1 x))) *
    ((0 x : E) -> (0 y : E) -> (f : Hom E e x y) ->
      MechCategory (Hom D d (F.1 (K.1 x)) (G.1 (K.1 y)))
        (comp D d (F.1 (K.1 x)) (F.1 (K.1 y)) (G.1 (K.1 y))
          (functorMap C D c d F (K.1 x) (K.1 y) (functorMap E C e c K x y f)) (app y))
        (comp D d (F.1 (K.1 x)) (G.1 (K.1 x)) (G.1 (K.1 y))
          (app x) (functorMap C D c d G (K.1 x) (K.1 y) (functorMap E C e c K x y f)))) :=
  fun (0 C : Sort (succ u)) (0 D : Sort (succ u)) (0 E : Sort (succ u))
      (c : Category C) (d : Category D) (e : Category E)
      (F : Functor C D c d) (G : Functor C D c d)
      (alpha : NatTrans C D c d F G) (K : Functor E C e c) =>
    ((fun (x : E) => alpha.1 (K.1 x)),
     (fun (0 x : E) (0 y : E) (f : Hom E e x y) =>
       naturality C D c d F G alpha (K.1 x) (K.1 y)
         (functorMap E C e c K x y f)))

-- UAT calls postcomposition whiskerLeft: map alpha's component through H.
def whiskerLeft : (0 C : Sort (succ u)) -> (0 D : Sort (succ u)) ->
    (0 E : Sort (succ u)) -> (c : Category C) -> (d : Category D) ->
    (e : Category E) -> (H : Functor D E d e) ->
    (F : Functor C D c d) -> (G : Functor C D c d) ->
    NatTrans C D c d F G ->
    (app : (x : C) -> Hom E e (H.1 (F.1 x)) (H.1 (G.1 x))) *
    ((0 x : C) -> (0 y : C) -> (f : Hom C c x y) ->
      MechCategory (Hom E e (H.1 (F.1 x)) (H.1 (G.1 y)))
        (comp E e (H.1 (F.1 x)) (H.1 (F.1 y)) (H.1 (G.1 y))
          (functorMap D E d e H (F.1 x) (F.1 y) (functorMap C D c d F x y f)) (app y))
        (comp E e (H.1 (F.1 x)) (H.1 (G.1 x)) (H.1 (G.1 y))
          (app x) (functorMap D E d e H (G.1 x) (G.1 y) (functorMap C D c d G x y f)))) :=
  fun (0 C : Sort (succ u)) (0 D : Sort (succ u)) (0 E : Sort (succ u))
      (c : Category C) (d : Category D) (e : Category E)
      (H : Functor D E d e) (F : Functor C D c d) (G : Functor C D c d)
      (alpha : NatTrans C D c d F G) =>
    ((fun (x : C) => functorMap D E d e H (F.1 x) (G.1 x) (alpha.1 x)),
     (fun (0 x : C) (0 y : C) (f : Hom C c x y) =>
       eqTrans (Hom E e (H.1 (F.1 x)) (H.1 (G.1 y))) (comp E e (H.1 (F.1 x)) (H.1 (F.1 y)) (H.1 (G.1
         y))
       (functorMap D E d e H (F.1 x) (F.1 y) (functorMap C D c d F x y f)) (functorMap D E d e H
       (F.1 y) (G.1 y) (alpha.1 y))) (functorMap D E d e H (F.1 x) (G.1 y)
       (comp D d (F.1 x) (F.1 y) (G.1 y) (functorMap C D c d F x y f) (alpha.1 y))) (comp E e (H.1
         (F.1 x)) (H.1 (G.1 x)) (H.1 (G.1 y))
       (functorMap D E d e H (F.1 x) (G.1 x) (alpha.1 x)) (functorMap D E d e H (G.1 x) (G.1 y)
       (functorMap C D c d G x y f)))
       (eqSymm (Hom E e (H.1 (F.1 x)) (H.1 (G.1 y))) (functorMap D E d e H (F.1 x) (G.1 y) (comp D d
       (F.1 x) (F.1 y) (G.1 y) (functorMap C D c d F x y f) (alpha.1 y))) (comp E e (H.1 (F.1 x))
         (H.1 (F.1 y)) (H.1 (G.1 y))
       (functorMap D E d e H (F.1 x) (F.1 y) (functorMap C D c d F x y f)) (functorMap D E d e H
       (F.1 y) (G.1 y) (alpha.1 y)))
       (functorMapComp D E d e H (F.1 x) (F.1 y) (G.1 y) (functorMap C D c d F x y f) (alpha.1 y)))
       (eqTrans (Hom E e (H.1 (F.1 x)) (H.1 (G.1 y))) (functorMap D E d e H (F.1 x) (G.1 y) (comp D
       d (F.1 x) (F.1 y) (G.1 y) (functorMap C D c d F x y f) (alpha.1 y))) (functorMap D E d e H
       (F.1 x) (G.1 y) (comp D d (F.1 x) (G.1 x) (G.1 y) (alpha.1 x) (functorMap C D c d G x y
       f))) (comp E e (H.1 (F.1 x)) (H.1 (G.1 x)) (H.1 (G.1 y))
       (functorMap D E d e H (F.1 x) (G.1 x) (alpha.1 x)) (functorMap D E d e H (G.1 x) (G.1 y)
       (functorMap C D c d G x y f)))
       (eqCongr (Hom D d (F.1 x) (G.1 y)) (Hom E e (H.1 (F.1 x)) (H.1 (G.1 y)))
       (fun (h : Hom D d (F.1 x) (G.1 y)) => functorMap D E d e H (F.1 x) (G.1 y) h)
       (comp D d (F.1 x) (F.1 y) (G.1 y) (functorMap C D c d F x y f) (alpha.1 y)) (comp D d (F.1 x)
       (G.1 x) (G.1 y) (alpha.1 x) (functorMap C D c d G x y f)) (naturality C D c d F G alpha x y
       f))
       (functorMapComp D E d e H (F.1 x) (G.1 x) (G.1 y) (alpha.1 x) (functorMap C D c d G x y
       f)))))

-- Generic projections keep the pair's carrier and fibre abstract.
def recordFirst : (0 A : Sort (max (succ u) (succ v))) -> (0 B : A -> Sort (max (succ u) (succ v)))
    ->
    ((a : A) * B a) -> A :=
  fun (0 A : Sort (max (succ u) (succ v))) (0 B : A -> Sort (max (succ u) (succ v)))
      (p : (a : A) * B a) => p.1
def recordSecond : (0 A : Sort (max (succ u) (succ v))) -> (0 B : A -> Sort (max (succ u) (succ v)))
    ->
    (p : (a : A) * B a) -> B (recordFirst A B p) :=
  fun (0 A : Sort (max (succ u) (succ v))) (0 B : A -> Sort (max (succ u) (succ v)))
      (p : (a : A) * B a) => p.2

-- A cocone F => K followed by G, with the composite maps expanded.
def LanCocone : (0 J : Sort (succ u)) -> (0 C : Sort (succ u)) ->
    (0 D : Sort (succ u)) -> (j : Category J) -> (c : Category C) ->
    (d : Category D) -> Functor J C j c -> Functor J D j d ->
    Functor C D c d -> Sort (max (succ u) (succ v)) :=
  fun (0 J : Sort (succ u)) (0 C : Sort (succ u)) (0 D : Sort (succ u))
      (j : Category J) (c : Category C) (d : Category D)
      (K : Functor J C j c) (F : Functor J D j d) (G : Functor C D c d) =>
    (app : (x : J) -> Hom D d (F.1 x) (G.1 (K.1 x))) *
    ((0 x : J) -> (0 y : J) -> (f : Hom J j x y) ->
      MechCategory (Hom D d (F.1 x) (G.1 (K.1 y)))
        (comp D d (F.1 x) (F.1 y) (G.1 (K.1 y))
          (functorMap J D j d F x y f) (app y))
        (comp D d (F.1 x) (G.1 (K.1 x)) (G.1 (K.1 y))
          (app x) (functorMap C D c d G (K.1 x) (K.1 y)
            (functorMap J C j c K x y f))))

-- The unit followed by a mediator at K's object equals the cocone.
def LanFactor : (0 J : Sort (succ u)) -> (0 C : Sort (succ u)) ->
    (0 D : Sort (succ u)) -> (j : Category J) -> (c : Category C) ->
    (d : Category D) -> (K : Functor J C j c) -> (F : Functor J D j d) ->
    (H : Functor C D c d) -> (G : Functor C D c d) ->
    LanCocone J C D j c d K F H -> LanCocone J C D j c d K F G ->
    NatTrans C D c d H G -> Prop :=
  fun (0 J : Sort (succ u)) (0 C : Sort (succ u)) (0 D : Sort (succ u))
      (j : Category J) (c : Category C) (d : Category D)
      (K : Functor J C j c) (F : Functor J D j d)
      (H : Functor C D c d) (G : Functor C D c d)
      (eta : LanCocone J C D j c d K F H)
      (alpha : LanCocone J C D j c d K F G)
      (beta : NatTrans C D c d H G) =>
    (x : J) -> MechCategory (Hom D d (F.1 x) (G.1 (K.1 x)))
      (comp D d (F.1 x) (H.1 (K.1 x)) (G.1 (K.1 x))
        (eta.1 x) (beta.1 (K.1 x))) (alpha.1 x)

-- Package each mediator with its factorization and uniqueness proofs.
def LanSolution : (0 J : Sort (succ u)) -> (0 C : Sort (succ u)) ->
    (0 D : Sort (succ u)) -> (j : Category J) -> (c : Category C) ->
    (d : Category D) -> (K : Functor J C j c) -> (F : Functor J D j d) ->
    (H : Functor C D c d) -> (G : Functor C D c d) ->
    LanCocone J C D j c d K F H -> LanCocone J C D j c d K F G ->
    Sort (max (succ u) (succ v)) :=
  fun (0 J : Sort (succ u)) (0 C : Sort (succ u)) (0 D : Sort (succ u))
      (j : Category J) (c : Category C) (d : Category D)
      (K : Functor J C j c) (F : Functor J D j d)
      (H : Functor C D c d) (G : Functor C D c d)
      (eta : LanCocone J C D j c d K F H)
      (alpha : LanCocone J C D j c d K F G) =>
    (beta : NatTrans C D c d H G) *
    (fac : LanFactor J C D j c d K F H G eta alpha beta) *
    ((other : NatTrans C D c d H G) ->
      LanFactor J C D j c d K F H G eta alpha other ->
      (y : C) -> MechCategory (Hom D d (H.1 y) (G.1 y))
        (other.1 y) (beta.1 y))

def LanTail : (0 J : Sort (succ u)) -> (0 C : Sort (succ u)) ->
    (0 D : Sort (succ u)) -> (j : Category J) -> (c : Category C) ->
    (d : Category D) -> (K : Functor J C j c) -> (F : Functor J D j d) ->
    (H : Functor C D c d) -> Sort (max (succ u) (succ v)) :=
  fun (0 J : Sort (succ u)) (0 C : Sort (succ u)) (0 D : Sort (succ u))
      (j : Category J) (c : Category C) (d : Category D)
      (K : Functor J C j c) (F : Functor J D j d) (H : Functor C D c d) =>
    (eta : LanCocone J C D j c d K F H) *
    ((G : Functor C D c d) -> (alpha : LanCocone J C D j c d K F G) ->
      LanSolution J C D j c d K F H G eta alpha)

def LeftKanExtension : (0 J : Sort (succ u)) -> (0 C : Sort (succ u)) ->
    (0 D : Sort (succ u)) -> (j : Category J) -> (c : Category C) ->
    (d : Category D) -> (K : Functor J C j c) -> (F : Functor J D j d) ->
    Sort (max (succ u) (succ v)) :=
  fun (0 J : Sort (succ u)) (0 C : Sort (succ u)) (0 D : Sort (succ u))
      (j : Category J) (c : Category C) (d : Category D)
      (K : Functor J C j c) (F : Functor J D j d) =>
    (H : Functor C D c d) * LanTail J C D j c d K F H

def lanFunctor : (0 J : Sort (succ u)) -> (0 C : Sort (succ u)) ->
    (0 D : Sort (succ u)) -> (0 j : Category J) -> (0 c : Category C) ->
    (0 d : Category D) -> (0 K : Functor J C j c) -> (0 F : Functor J D j d) ->
    LeftKanExtension J C D j c d K F -> Functor C D c d :=
  fun (0 J : Sort (succ u)) (0 C : Sort (succ u)) (0 D : Sort (succ u))
      (0 j : Category J) (0 c : Category C) (0 d : Category D)
      (0 K : Functor J C j c) (0 F : Functor J D j d) (L : LeftKanExtension J C D j c d K F) =>
    recordFirst (Functor C D c d)
      (fun (H : Functor C D c d) => LanTail J C D j c d K F H) L

def lanTail : (0 J : Sort (succ u)) -> (0 C : Sort (succ u)) ->
    (0 D : Sort (succ u)) -> (0 j : Category J) -> (0 c : Category C) ->
    (0 d : Category D) -> (0 K : Functor J C j c) -> (0 F : Functor J D j d) ->
    (L : LeftKanExtension J C D j c d K F) -> LanTail J C D j c d K F (lanFunctor J C D j c d K F L)
    :=
  fun (0 J : Sort (succ u)) (0 C : Sort (succ u)) (0 D : Sort (succ u))
      (0 j : Category J) (0 c : Category C) (0 d : Category D)
      (0 K : Functor J C j c) (0 F : Functor J D j d) (L : LeftKanExtension J C D j c d K F) =>
    recordSecond (Functor C D c d)
      (fun (H : Functor C D c d) => LanTail J C D j c d K F H) L

def lanUnit : (0 J : Sort (succ u)) -> (0 C : Sort (succ u)) ->
    (0 D : Sort (succ u)) -> (0 j : Category J) -> (0 c : Category C) ->
    (0 d : Category D) -> (0 K : Functor J C j c) -> (0 F : Functor J D j d) ->
    (L : LeftKanExtension J C D j c d K F) -> LanCocone J C D j c d K F (lanFunctor J C D j c d K F
    L) :=
  fun (0 J : Sort (succ u)) (0 C : Sort (succ u)) (0 D : Sort (succ u))
      (0 j : Category J) (0 c : Category C) (0 d : Category D)
      (0 K : Functor J C j c) (0 F : Functor J D j d) (L : LeftKanExtension J C D j c d K F) =>
    recordFirst (LanCocone J C D j c d K F (lanFunctor J C D j c d K F L))
      (fun (eta : LanCocone J C D j c d K F (lanFunctor J C D j c d K F L)) =>
        (G : Functor C D c d) -> (alpha : LanCocone J C D j c d K F G) ->
          LanSolution J C D j c d K F (lanFunctor J C D j c d K F L) G eta alpha)
      (lanTail J C D j c d K F L)

def lanSolve : (0 J : Sort (succ u)) -> (0 C : Sort (succ u)) ->
    (0 D : Sort (succ u)) -> (0 j : Category J) -> (0 c : Category C) ->
    (0 d : Category D) -> (0 K : Functor J C j c) -> (0 F : Functor J D j d) ->
    (L : LeftKanExtension J C D j c d K F) -> (G : Functor C D c d) ->
    (alpha : LanCocone J C D j c d K F G) ->
    LanSolution J C D j c d K F (lanFunctor J C D j c d K F L) G (lanUnit J C D j c d K F L) alpha
    :=
  fun (0 J : Sort (succ u)) (0 C : Sort (succ u)) (0 D : Sort (succ u))
      (0 j : Category J) (0 c : Category C) (0 d : Category D)
      (0 K : Functor J C j c) (0 F : Functor J D j d) (L : LeftKanExtension J C D j c d K F) =>
    recordSecond (LanCocone J C D j c d K F (lanFunctor J C D j c d K F L))
      (fun (eta : LanCocone J C D j c d K F (lanFunctor J C D j c d K F L)) =>
        (G : Functor C D c d) -> (alpha : LanCocone J C D j c d K F G) ->
          LanSolution J C D j c d K F (lanFunctor J C D j c d K F L) G eta alpha)
      (lanTail J C D j c d K F L)

def lanDesc : (0 J : Sort (succ u)) -> (0 C : Sort (succ u)) ->
    (0 D : Sort (succ u)) -> (0 j : Category J) -> (0 c : Category C) ->
    (0 d : Category D) -> (0 K : Functor J C j c) -> (0 F : Functor J D j d) ->
    (0 H : Functor C D c d) -> (0 G : Functor C D c d) ->
    (0 eta : LanCocone J C D j c d K F H) -> (0 alpha : LanCocone J C D j c d K F G) ->
    (s : LanSolution J C D j c d K F H G eta alpha) -> NatTrans C D c d H G :=

      (0 j : Category J) (0 c : Category C) (0 d : Category D)
      (0 K : Functor J C j c) (0 F : Functor J D j d) (0 H : Functor C D c d) (0 G : Functor C D c d)
      (0 eta : LanCocone J C D j c d K F H) (0 alpha : LanCocone J C D j c d K F G)
      (s : LanSolution J C D j c d K F H G eta alpha) => s.1

def lanFac : (0 J : Sort (succ u)) -> (0 C : Sort (succ u)) ->
    (0 D : Sort (succ u)) -> (j : Category J) -> (c : Category C) ->
    (d : Category D) -> (K : Functor J C j c) -> (F : Functor J D j d) ->
    (H : Functor C D c d) -> (G : Functor C D c d) ->
    (eta : LanCocone J C D j c d K F H) -> (alpha : LanCocone J C D j c d K F G) ->
    (s : LanSolution J C D j c d K F H G eta alpha) -> LanFactor J C D j c d K F H G eta alpha (s.1)
    :=
  fun (0 J : Sort (succ u)) (0 C : Sort (succ u)) (0 D : Sort (succ u))
      (j : Category J) (c : Category C) (d : Category D)
      (K : Functor J C j c) (F : Functor J D j d) (H : Functor C D c d) (G : Functor C D c d)
      (eta : LanCocone J C D j c d K F H) (alpha : LanCocone J C D j c d K F G)
      (s : LanSolution J C D j c d K F H G eta alpha) => s.2.1

def lanUniq : (0 J : Sort (succ u)) -> (0 C : Sort (succ u)) ->
    (0 D : Sort (succ u)) -> (j : Category J) -> (c : Category C) ->
    (d : Category D) -> (K : Functor J C j c) -> (F : Functor J D j d) ->
    (H : Functor C D c d) -> (G : Functor C D c d) ->
    (eta : LanCocone J C D j c d K F H) -> (alpha : LanCocone J C D j c d K F G) ->
    (s : LanSolution J C D j c d K F H G eta alpha) -> (beta : NatTrans C D c d H G) ->
    LanFactor J C D j c d K F H G eta alpha beta ->
    (y : C) -> MechCategory (Hom D d (H.1 y) (G.1 y))
      (beta.1 y) ((s.1).1 y) :=
  fun (0 J : Sort (succ u)) (0 C : Sort (succ u)) (0 D : Sort (succ u))
      (j : Category J) (c : Category C) (d : Category D)
      (K : Functor J C j c) (F : Functor J D j d) (H : Functor C D c d) (G : Functor C D c d)
      (eta : LanCocone J C D j c d K F H) (alpha : LanCocone J C D j c d K F G)
      (s : LanSolution J C D j c d K F H G eta alpha) => s.2.2

-- Two mediators that factor the same cocone agree at every object.
def desc_unique : (0 J : Sort (succ u)) -> (0 C : Sort (succ u)) ->
    (0 D : Sort (succ u)) -> (j : Category J) -> (c : Category C) ->
    (d : Category D) -> (K : Functor J C j c) -> (F : Functor J D j d) ->
    (H : Functor C D c d) -> (G : Functor C D c d) ->
    (eta : LanCocone J C D j c d K F H) -> (alpha : LanCocone J C D j c d K F G) ->
    (s : LanSolution J C D j c d K F H G eta alpha) ->
    (beta1 : NatTrans C D c d H G) -> (beta2 : NatTrans C D c d H G) ->
    LanFactor J C D j c d K F H G eta alpha beta1 ->
    LanFactor J C D j c d K F H G eta alpha beta2 ->
    (y : C) -> MechCategory (Hom D d (H.1 y) (G.1 y))
      (beta1.1 y) (beta2.1 y) :=
  fun (0 J : Sort (succ u)) (0 C : Sort (succ u)) (0 D : Sort (succ u))
      (j : Category J) (c : Category C) (d : Category D)
      (K : Functor J C j c) (F : Functor J D j d) (H : Functor C D c d) (G : Functor C D c d)
      (eta : LanCocone J C D j c d K F H) (alpha : LanCocone J C D j c d K F G)
      (s : LanSolution J C D j c d K F H G eta alpha)
      (beta1 : NatTrans C D c d H G) (beta2 : NatTrans C D c d H G)
      (h1 : LanFactor J C D j c d K F H G eta alpha beta1)
      (h2 : LanFactor J C D j c d K F H G eta alpha beta2) (y : C) =>
    eqTrans (Hom D d (H.1 y) (G.1 y))
      (beta1.1 y) ((s.1).1 y) (beta2.1 y)
      (lanUniq J C D j c d K F H G eta alpha s beta1 h1 y)
      (eqSymm (Hom D d (H.1 y) (G.1 y)) (beta2.1 y) ((s.1).1 y)
        (lanUniq J C D j c d K F H G eta alpha s beta2 h2 y))
end

mu Tiny : Type 0 with | zero : Tiny | next : Tiny -> Tiny
mu Point : Type 0 with | point : Point
mu Path (0 x : Tiny) : (0 y : Tiny) -> Prop with | same : Path x x
specialize MechCategory (0, 0) as Small

def pathTrans : (0 x : Tiny) -> (0 y : Tiny) -> (0 z : Tiny) ->
    Path x y -> Path y z -> Path x z :=
  fun (0 x : Tiny) (0 y : Tiny) (0 z : Tiny) (f : Path x y) (g : Path y z) =>
    match g as self in Path right return Path x right with | same => f
def IndexedEnd : Small_Category Tiny :=
  ((fun (0 x : Tiny) (0 y : Tiny) => (Path x y) * (Tiny -> Tiny)),
   ((fun (0 x : Tiny) => (same, (fun (n : Tiny) => n))),
    ((fun (0 x : Tiny) (0 y : Tiny) (0 z : Tiny)
          (f : (Path x y) * (Tiny -> Tiny)) (g : (Path y z) * (Tiny -> Tiny)) =>
        (pathTrans x y z f.1 g.1, (fun (n : Tiny) => g.2 (f.2 n)))),
     ((fun (0 x : Tiny) (0 y : Tiny) (0 f : (Path x y) * (Tiny -> Tiny)) => categoryRefl),
      ((fun (0 x : Tiny) (0 y : Tiny) (0 f : (Path x y) * (Tiny -> Tiny)) => categoryRefl),
       (fun (0 w : Tiny) (0 x : Tiny) (0 y : Tiny) (0 z : Tiny)
            (0 f : (Path w x) * (Tiny -> Tiny))
            (0 g : (Path x y) * (Tiny -> Tiny))
            (0 h : (Path y z) * (Tiny -> Tiny)) => categoryRefl))))))

def DoubleEnd : Small_Category Point :=
  ((fun (0 x : Point) (0 y : Point) => (Tiny -> Tiny) * (Tiny -> Tiny)),
   ((fun (0 x : Point) => ((fun (n : Tiny) => n), (fun (n : Tiny) => n))),
    ((fun (0 x : Point) (0 y : Point) (0 z : Point)
          (f : (Tiny -> Tiny) * (Tiny -> Tiny))
          (g : (Tiny -> Tiny) * (Tiny -> Tiny)) =>
       ((fun (n : Tiny) => g.1 (f.1 n)), (fun (n : Tiny) => g.2 (f.2 n)))),
     ((fun (0 x : Point) (0 y : Point) (0 f : (Tiny -> Tiny) * (Tiny -> Tiny)) =>
         categoryRefl),
      ((fun (0 x : Point) (0 y : Point) (0 f : (Tiny -> Tiny) * (Tiny -> Tiny)) =>
          categoryRefl),
       (fun (0 w : Point) (0 x : Point) (0 y : Point) (0 z : Point)
            (0 f : (Tiny -> Tiny) * (Tiny -> Tiny))
            (0 g : (Tiny -> Tiny) * (Tiny -> Tiny))
            (0 h : (Tiny -> Tiny) * (Tiny -> Tiny)) => categoryRefl))))))
def Constant : Small_Functor Tiny Point IndexedEnd DoubleEnd :=
  ((fun (x : Tiny) => point),
   ((fun (0 x : Tiny) (0 y : Tiny) (f : (Path x y) * (Tiny -> Tiny)) =>
       ((fun (n : Tiny) => n), (fun (n : Tiny) => n))),
    ((fun (0 x : Tiny) => categoryRefl),
     (fun (0 x : Tiny) (0 y : Tiny) (0 z : Tiny)
          (0 f : (Path x y) * (Tiny -> Tiny)) (0 g : (Path y z) * (Tiny -> Tiny)) => categoryRefl))))
def Components : (x : Tiny) -> (Tiny -> Tiny) * (Tiny -> Tiny) :=
  fun (x : Tiny) => ((fun (n : Tiny) => x), (fun (n : Tiny) => n))
def componentLaw : (0 x : Tiny) -> (0 y : Tiny) -> Path x y ->
    Small ((Tiny -> Tiny) * (Tiny -> Tiny)) (Components y) (Components x) :=
  fun (0 x : Tiny) (0 y : Tiny) (proof : Path x y) =>
    match proof as self in Path right return
      Small ((Tiny -> Tiny) * (Tiny -> Tiny)) (Components right) (Components x) with
    | same => categoryRefl
def Alpha : Small_NatTrans Tiny Point IndexedEnd DoubleEnd Constant Constant :=
  (Components,
   (fun (0 x : Tiny) (0 y : Tiny) (f : (Path x y) * (Tiny -> Tiny)) =>
     componentLaw x y f.1))
def Beta : Small_NatTrans Tiny Point IndexedEnd DoubleEnd Constant Constant :=
  ((fun (x : Tiny) => ((fun (n : Tiny) => next n), (fun (n : Tiny) => next n))),
   (fun (0 x : Tiny) (0 y : Tiny) (f : (Path x y) * (Tiny -> Tiny)) => categoryRefl))

def Jump : Small_Functor Tiny Tiny IndexedEnd IndexedEnd :=
  ((fun (x : Tiny) => next zero),
   ((fun (0 x : Tiny) (0 y : Tiny) (f : (Path x y) * (Tiny -> Tiny)) => (same, (fun (n : Tiny) => n))),
    ((fun (0 x : Tiny) => categoryRefl),
     (fun (0 x : Tiny) (0 y : Tiny) (0 z : Tiny)
          (0 f : (Path x y) * (Tiny -> Tiny)) (0 g : (Path y z) * (Tiny -> Tiny)) => categoryRefl))))
def Swap : Small_Functor Point Point DoubleEnd DoubleEnd :=
  ((fun (x : Point) => x),
   ((fun (0 x : Point) (0 y : Point) (f : (Tiny -> Tiny) * (Tiny -> Tiny)) =>
       (f.2, f.1)),
    ((fun (0 x : Point) => categoryRefl),
     (fun (0 x : Point) (0 y : Point) (0 z : Point)
          (0 f : (Tiny -> Tiny) * (Tiny -> Tiny))
          (0 g : (Tiny -> Tiny) * (Tiny -> Tiny)) => categoryRefl))))

def componentValue : Tiny :=
  (Small_natApp Tiny Point IndexedEnd DoubleEnd Constant Constant Alpha (next zero)).1 zero
def identityValue : Tiny :=
  ((Small_idNat Tiny Point IndexedEnd DoubleEnd Constant).1 zero).1 (next zero)
def verticalForward : Tiny :=
  ((Small_vcomp Tiny Point IndexedEnd DoubleEnd Constant Constant Constant Alpha Beta).1 zero).1 zero
def verticalReverse : Tiny :=
  ((Small_vcomp Tiny Point IndexedEnd DoubleEnd Constant Constant Constant Beta Alpha).1 zero).1 zero
def verticalNested : Tiny :=
  ((Small_vcomp Tiny Point IndexedEnd DoubleEnd Constant Constant Constant
    (Small_vcomp Tiny Point IndexedEnd DoubleEnd Constant Constant Constant Alpha Beta)
    Beta).1 zero).1 zero
def Right : Small_NatTrans Tiny Point IndexedEnd DoubleEnd
    (Small_compFunctor Tiny Tiny Point IndexedEnd IndexedEnd DoubleEnd Jump Constant)
    (Small_compFunctor Tiny Tiny Point IndexedEnd IndexedEnd DoubleEnd Jump Constant) :=
  Small_whiskerRight Tiny Point Tiny IndexedEnd DoubleEnd IndexedEnd Constant Constant Alpha Jump
def Left : Small_NatTrans Tiny Point IndexedEnd DoubleEnd
    (Small_compFunctor Tiny Point Point IndexedEnd DoubleEnd DoubleEnd Constant Swap)
    (Small_compFunctor Tiny Point Point IndexedEnd DoubleEnd DoubleEnd Constant Swap) :=
  Small_whiskerLeft Tiny Point Point IndexedEnd DoubleEnd DoubleEnd Swap Constant Constant Alpha
def rightValue : Tiny :=
  (Right.1 zero).1 zero
def leftValue : Tiny :=
  (Left.1 zero).1 (next zero)
def leftOther : Tiny :=
  (Left.1 zero).2 (next zero)

def genericComponent : (0 C : Type 0) -> (0 D : Type 0) ->
    (c : Small_Category C) -> (d : Small_Category D) ->
    (F : Small_Functor C D c d) -> (G : Small_Functor C D c d) ->
    Small_NatTrans C D c d F G -> (x : C) -> Small_Hom D d (F.1 x) (G.1 x) :=
  Small_natApp
specialize MechCategory (1, 0) as Types
specialize MechCategory (0, 1) as Up
specialize MechCategory (2, 1) as Higher
def higherIdentity : (0 C : Type 2) -> (0 D : Type 2) ->
    (c : Higher_Category C) -> (d : Higher_Category D) ->
    (F : Higher_Functor C D c d) -> Higher_NatTrans C D c d F F := Higher_idNat
def upIdentity : (0 C : Type 0) -> (0 D : Type 0) ->
    (c : Up_Category C) -> (d : Up_Category D) ->
    (F : Up_Functor C D c d) -> Up_NatTrans C D c d F F := Up_idNat

-- The extension along an identity functor exists in every category.
def identityLan : (0 C : Type 0) -> (0 D : Type 0) ->
    (c : Small_Category C) -> (d : Small_Category D) ->
    (F : Small_Functor C D c d) ->
    Small_LeftKanExtension C C D c c d (Small_idFunctor C c) F :=
  fun (0 C : Type 0) (0 D : Type 0) (c : Small_Category C)
      (d : Small_Category D) (F : Small_Functor C D c d) =>
    (F, (Small_idNat C D c d F,
     (fun (G : Small_Functor C D c d)
           (alpha : Small_LanCocone C C D c c d (Small_idFunctor C c) F G) =>
         ((alpha.1, alpha.2),
      ((fun (x : C) => Small_idComp D d (F.1 x) (G.1 x) (alpha.1 x)),
       (fun (beta : Small_NatTrans C D c d F G)
            (h : Small_LanFactor C C D c c d (Small_idFunctor C c) F F G
              (Small_idNat C D c d F) alpha beta) (y : C) =>
         Small_eqTrans (Small_Hom D d (F.1 y) (G.1 y))
           (beta.1 y)
           (Small_comp D d (F.1 y) (F.1 y) (G.1 y)
             (Small_id D d (F.1 y)) (beta.1 y)) (alpha.1 y)
           (Small_eqSymm (Small_Hom D d (F.1 y) (G.1 y))
             (Small_comp D d (F.1 y) (F.1 y) (G.1 y)
               (Small_id D d (F.1 y)) (beta.1 y)) (beta.1 y)
             (Small_idComp D d (F.1 y) (G.1 y) (beta.1 y))) (h y)))))))

-- These contracts use the original natural transformation operations.
def coconeContract : (0 J : Type 0) -> (0 C : Type 0) -> (0 D : Type 0) ->
    (j : Small_Category J) -> (c : Small_Category C) -> (d : Small_Category D) ->
    (K : Small_Functor J C j c) -> (F : Small_Functor J D j d) ->
    (G : Small_Functor C D c d) ->
    Small_NatTrans J D j d F (Small_compFunctor J C D j c d K G) ->
    Small_LanCocone J C D j c d K F G :=
  fun (0 J : Type 0) (0 C : Type 0) (0 D : Type 0)
      (j : Small_Category J) (c : Small_Category C) (d : Small_Category D)
      (K : Small_Functor J C j c) (F : Small_Functor J D j d)
      (G : Small_Functor C D c d)
      (alpha : Small_NatTrans J D j d F (Small_compFunctor J C D j c d K G)) =>
    alpha

def factorContract : (0 J : Type 0) -> (0 C : Type 0) -> (0 D : Type 0) ->
    (j : Small_Category J) -> (c : Small_Category C) -> (d : Small_Category D) ->
    (K : Small_Functor J C j c) -> (F : Small_Functor J D j d) ->
    (H : Small_Functor C D c d) -> (G : Small_Functor C D c d) ->
    (eta : Small_LanCocone J C D j c d K F H) ->
    (alpha : Small_LanCocone J C D j c d K F G) ->
    (s : Small_LanSolution J C D j c d K F H G eta alpha) ->
    (x : J) -> Small (Small_Hom D d (F.1 x) (G.1 (K.1 x)))
      (Small_comp D d (F.1 x) (H.1 (K.1 x)) (G.1 (K.1 x))
        (eta.1 x)
        ((Small_whiskerRight C D J c d j H G
          (Small_lanDesc J C D j c d K F H G eta alpha s) K).1 x))
      (alpha.1 x) := Small_lanFac

def uniqueContract : (0 J : Type 0) -> (0 C : Type 0) -> (0 D : Type 0) ->
    (j : Small_Category J) -> (c : Small_Category C) -> (d : Small_Category D) ->
    (K : Small_Functor J C j c) -> (F : Small_Functor J D j d) ->
    (H : Small_Functor C D c d) -> (G : Small_Functor C D c d) ->
    (eta : Small_LanCocone J C D j c d K F H) ->
    (alpha : Small_LanCocone J C D j c d K F G) ->
    (s : Small_LanSolution J C D j c d K F H G eta alpha) ->
    (beta1 : Small_NatTrans C D c d H G) ->
    (beta2 : Small_NatTrans C D c d H G) ->
    Small_LanFactor J C D j c d K F H G eta alpha beta1 ->
    Small_LanFactor J C D j c d K F H G eta alpha beta2 ->
    (y : C) -> Small (Small_Hom D d (H.1 y) (G.1 y))
      (Small_natApp C D c d H G beta1 y)
      (Small_natApp C D c d H G beta2 y) := Small_desc_unique

def Identity : Small_Functor Tiny Tiny IndexedEnd IndexedEnd :=
  Small_idFunctor Tiny IndexedEnd
def Extension : Small_LeftKanExtension Tiny Tiny Point IndexedEnd IndexedEnd DoubleEnd Identity
    Constant :=
  identityLan Tiny Point IndexedEnd DoubleEnd Constant
def Eta : Small_LanCocone Tiny Tiny Point IndexedEnd IndexedEnd DoubleEnd Identity Constant Constant
    :=
  Small_lanUnit Tiny Tiny Point IndexedEnd IndexedEnd DoubleEnd Identity Constant Extension
def Chosen : Small_LanSolution Tiny Tiny Point IndexedEnd IndexedEnd DoubleEnd Identity Constant
    Constant Constant Eta Alpha :=
  Small_lanSolve Tiny Tiny Point IndexedEnd IndexedEnd DoubleEnd Identity Constant Extension
    Constant Alpha
def OtherChosen : Small_LanSolution Tiny Tiny Point IndexedEnd IndexedEnd DoubleEnd Identity
    Constant Constant Constant Eta Beta :=
  Small_lanSolve Tiny Tiny Point IndexedEnd IndexedEnd DoubleEnd Identity Constant Extension
    Constant Beta
def Mediator : Small_NatTrans Tiny Point IndexedEnd DoubleEnd Constant Constant :=
  Small_lanDesc Tiny Tiny Point IndexedEnd IndexedEnd DoubleEnd Identity Constant Constant Constant
    Eta Alpha Chosen
def OtherMediator : Small_NatTrans Tiny Point IndexedEnd DoubleEnd Constant Constant :=
  Small_lanDesc Tiny Tiny Point IndexedEnd IndexedEnd DoubleEnd Identity Constant Constant Constant
    Eta Beta OtherChosen
def lanUnitValue : Tiny := (Eta.1 (next zero)).2 (next zero)
def lanMapValue : Tiny :=
  (Small_functorMap Point Point DoubleEnd DoubleEnd
    (Small_lanFunctor Point Point Point DoubleEnd DoubleEnd DoubleEnd
      (Small_idFunctor Point DoubleEnd) Swap
      (identityLan Point Point DoubleEnd DoubleEnd Swap)) point point
    ((fun (n : Tiny) => next n), (fun (n : Tiny) => n))).2 (next zero)
def lanDescValue : Tiny := (Mediator.1 (next zero)).1 zero
def lanDescOther : Tiny := (OtherMediator.1 zero).1 (next zero)
def lanDescObject : Tiny :=
  (Mediator.1 zero).1 (next zero)
def lanDescSecond : Tiny := (Mediator.1 zero).2 (next zero)
def lanFacProof : Small ((Tiny -> Tiny) * (Tiny -> Tiny))
    (Small_comp Point DoubleEnd point point point
      (Eta.1 (next zero)) (Mediator.1 (next zero))) (Alpha.1 (next zero)) :=
  Small_lanFac Tiny Tiny Point IndexedEnd IndexedEnd DoubleEnd Identity Constant Constant Constant
    Eta Alpha Chosen (next zero)
def lanUniqueProof : Small ((Tiny -> Tiny) * (Tiny -> Tiny))
    (Alpha.1 (next zero)) (Mediator.1 (next zero)) :=
  Small_desc_unique Tiny Tiny Point IndexedEnd IndexedEnd DoubleEnd Identity Constant Constant
    Constant Eta Alpha Chosen Alpha Mediator
    (fun (x : Tiny) => categoryRefl)
    (Small_lanFac Tiny Tiny Point IndexedEnd IndexedEnd DoubleEnd Identity Constant Constant
    Constant Eta Alpha Chosen) (next zero)
def higherLan : (0 J : Type 2) -> (0 C : Type 2) -> (0 D : Type 2) ->
    (0 j : Higher_Category J) -> (0 c : Higher_Category C) -> (0 d : Higher_Category D) ->
    (0 K : Higher_Functor J C j c) -> (0 F : Higher_Functor J D j d) ->
    Higher_LeftKanExtension J C D j c d K F -> Higher_Functor C D c d :=
  Higher_lanFunctor

-- Checked data at the first data universe.  No declaration uses the
-- driver's initial Nat axiom or its literal primitives.

mu MechNat : Type 0 with
| mechZero : MechNat
| mechSucc : MechNat -> MechNat

mu MechBool : Type 0 with
| mechFalse : MechBool
| mechTrue : MechBool

mu MechUnit : Type 0 with
| mechUnit : MechUnit

mu MechEmpty : Type 0 with

mu MechFalse : Prop with

mu MechTrue : Prop with
| mechTrivial : MechTrue

mu MechSum (0 A : Type 0) (0 B : Type 0) : Type 0 with
| mechInl : A -> MechSum A B
| mechInr : B -> MechSum A B

mu MechDecidable (0 P : Prop) : Type 0 with
| mechIsFalse : (0 refute : P -> MechFalse) -> MechDecidable P
| mechIsTrue : (0 proof : P) -> MechDecidable P

def MechPi : (0 A : Type 0) -> (0 B : A -> Type 0) -> Type 0 :=
  fun (0 A : Type 0) (0 B : A -> Type 0) => (x : A) -> B x

def MechSigma : (0 A : Type 0) -> (0 B : A -> Type 0) -> Type 0 :=
  fun (0 A : Type 0) (0 B : A -> Type 0) => (x : A) * B x

def mechBoolRec : (0 A : Type 0) -> A -> A -> MechBool -> A :=
  fun (0 A : Type 0) (no : A) (yes : A) (b : MechBool) =>
    case b as self in MechBool return A with
    | mechFalse => no
    | mechTrue => yes

def mechEmptyElim : (0 A : Type 0) -> MechEmpty -> A :=
  fun (0 A : Type 0) (e : MechEmpty) =>
    case e as self in MechEmpty return A with

def mechFalseElim : (0 A : Type 0) -> MechFalse -> A :=
  fun (0 A : Type 0) (e : MechFalse) =>
    case e as self in MechFalse return A with

def mechSumRec : (0 A : Type 0) -> (0 B : Type 0) ->
    (0 C : Type 0) -> (A -> C) -> (B -> C) -> MechSum A B -> C :=
  fun (0 A : Type 0) (0 B : Type 0) (0 C : Type 0)
    (left : A -> C) (right : B -> C) (s : MechSum A B) =>
      case s as self in MechSum return C with
      | mechInl a => left a
      | mechInr b => right b

def rec mechNatRec : (0 P : MechNat -> Type 0) -> P mechZero ->
    ((n : MechNat) -> P n -> P (mechSucc n)) -> (n : MechNat) -> P n :=
  fun (0 P : MechNat -> Type 0) (zero : P mechZero)
    (step : (n : MechNat) -> P n -> P (mechSucc n)) (n : MechNat) =>
      case n as self in MechNat return P self with
      | mechZero => zero
      | mechSucc previous => step previous (mechNatRec P zero step previous)

def mechDecidableBool : (0 P : Prop) -> MechDecidable P -> MechBool :=
  fun (0 P : Prop) (d : MechDecidable P) =>
    case d as self in MechDecidable return MechBool with
    | mechIsFalse 0 refute => mechFalse
    | mechIsTrue 0 proof => mechTrue

-- Equality keeps its endpoints erased and carries no constructor field.
-- The singleton criterion therefore admits elimination into data.
mu MechEq (0 A : Type 0) (0 x : A) : (0 y : A) -> Prop with
| mechReflCtor : MechEq A x x

def mechRefl : (0 A : Type 0) -> (0 x : A) -> MechEq A x x :=
  fun (0 A : Type 0) (0 x : A) => mechReflCtor

def mechJ : (0 A : Type 0) -> (0 x : A) ->
    (0 P : (0 y : A) -> (0 e : MechEq A x y) -> Type 0) ->
    P x (mechRefl A x) -> (0 y : A) -> (e : MechEq A x y) -> P y e :=
  fun (0 A : Type 0) (0 x : A)
    (0 P : (0 y : A) -> (0 e : MechEq A x y) -> Type 0)
    (reflCase : P x (mechRefl A x)) (0 y : A) (e : MechEq A x y) =>
      case e as self in MechEq right return P right self with
      | mechReflCtor => reflCase

def mechTransport : (0 A : Type 0) -> (0 B : A -> Type 0) ->
    (0 x : A) -> (0 y : A) -> MechEq A x y -> B x -> B y :=
  fun (0 A : Type 0) (0 B : A -> Type 0)
    (0 x : A) (0 y : A) (e : MechEq A x y) (value : B x) =>
      mechJ A x (fun (0 right : A) (0 proof : MechEq A x right) => B right)
        value y e

def mechSymm : (0 A : Type 0) -> (0 x : A) -> (0 y : A) ->
    MechEq A x y -> MechEq A y x :=
  fun (0 A : Type 0) (0 x : A) (0 y : A) (e : MechEq A x y) =>
    case e as self in MechEq right return MechEq A right x with
    | mechReflCtor => mechRefl A x

def mechTrans : (0 A : Type 0) -> (0 x : A) -> (0 y : A) -> (0 z : A) ->
    MechEq A x y -> MechEq A y z -> MechEq A x z :=
  fun (0 A : Type 0) (0 x : A) (0 y : A) (0 z : A)
    (first : MechEq A x y) (second : MechEq A y z) =>
      case second as self in MechEq right return MechEq A x right with
      | mechReflCtor => first

def mechCongr : (0 A : Type 0) -> (0 B : Type 0) -> (0 f : A -> B) ->
    (0 x : A) -> (0 y : A) -> MechEq A x y -> MechEq B (f x) (f y) :=
  fun (0 A : Type 0) (0 B : Type 0) (0 f : A -> B)
    (0 x : A) (0 y : A) (e : MechEq A x y) =>
      case e as self in MechEq right return MechEq B (f x) (f right) with
      | mechReflCtor => mechRefl B (f x)

-- The older proof equality has a relevant constructor witness, so it
-- remains an example whose elimination into data is rejected.
mu MechProofEq (0 A : Prop) : (0 x : A) -> (0 y : A) -> Prop with
| mechProofReflCtor : (x : A) -> MechProofEq A x x

def mechProofRefl : (0 A : Prop) -> (x : A) -> MechProofEq A x x :=
  fun (0 A : Prop) (x : A) => mechProofReflCtor x

def mechProofJ : (0 A : Prop) ->
    (0 P : (0 x : A) -> (0 y : A) -> (0 e : MechProofEq A x y) -> Prop) ->
    ((x : A) -> P x x (mechProofRefl A x)) ->
    (0 x : A) -> (0 y : A) -> (e : MechProofEq A x y) -> P x y e :=
  fun (0 A : Prop)
    (0 P : (0 x : A) -> (0 y : A) -> (0 e : MechProofEq A x y) -> Prop)
    (reflCase : (x : A) -> P x x (mechProofRefl A x))
    (0 x : A) (0 y : A) (e : MechProofEq A x y) =>
      case e as self in MechProofEq left right return P left right self with
      | mechProofReflCtor witness => reflCase witness

-- Categories have independent object and morphism Type levels.
-- The equality family and all members specialize together.
poly (u, v) mu MechCategoryCore (0 A : Sort (succ v)) (0 x : A) :
    (0 y : A) -> Prop with
| categoryRefl : MechCategoryCore A x x
where
def Category : (0 Obj : Sort (succ u)) -> Sort (max (succ u) (succ (succ v))) :=
  fun (0 Obj : Sort (succ u)) =>
    (hom : (0 x : Obj) -> (0 y : Obj) -> Sort (succ v)) *
    (identity : (0 x : Obj) -> hom x x) *
    (compose : (0 x : Obj) -> (0 y : Obj) -> (0 z : Obj) ->
      hom x y -> hom y z -> hom x z) *
    (left : (0 x : Obj) -> (0 y : Obj) -> (0 f : hom x y) ->
      MechCategoryCore (hom x y) (compose x x y (identity x) f) f) *
    (right : (0 x : Obj) -> (0 y : Obj) -> (0 f : hom x y) ->

-- Two naturality squares compose using the category laws.
def vcompLaw : (0 D : Sort (succ w)) -> (d : Base_Target_Category D) ->
    (0 fx : D) -> (0 fy : D) -> (0 gx : D) -> (0 gy : D) -> (0 hx : D) -> (0 hy : D) ->
    (0 fm : Base_Target_Hom D d fx fy) -> (0 gm : Base_Target_Hom D d gx gy) -> (0 hm : Base_Target_Hom D d hx hy) ->
    (0 ax : Base_Target_Hom D d fx gx) -> (0 ay : Base_Target_Hom D d fy gy) ->
    (0 bx : Base_Target_Hom D d gx hx) -> (0 by : Base_Target_Hom D d gy hy) ->
    Base_Target (Base_Target_Hom D d fx gy) (Base_Target_comp D d fx fy gy fm ay) (Base_Target_comp D d fx gx gy ax gm) ->
    Base_Target (Base_Target_Hom D d gx hy) (Base_Target_comp D d gx gy hy gm by) (Base_Target_comp D d gx hx hy bx hm) ->
    Base_Target (Base_Target_Hom D d fx hy)
      (Base_Target_comp D d fx fy hy fm (Base_Target_comp D d fy gy hy ay by))
      (Base_Target_comp D d fx hx hy (Base_Target_comp D d fx gx hx ax bx) hm) :=
  fun (0 D : Sort (succ w)) (d : Base_Target_Category D)
      (0 fx : D) (0 fy : D) (0 gx : D) (0 gy : D) (0 hx : D) (0 hy : D)
      (0 fm : Base_Target_Hom D d fx fy) (0 gm : Base_Target_Hom D d gx gy) (0 hm : Base_Target_Hom D d hx hy)
      (0 ax : Base_Target_Hom D d fx gx) (0 ay : Base_Target_Hom D d fy gy)
      (0 bx : Base_Target_Hom D d gx hx) (0 by : Base_Target_Hom D d gy hy)
      (first : Base_Target (Base_Target_Hom D d fx gy)
        (Base_Target_comp D d fx fy gy fm ay) (Base_Target_comp D d fx gx gy ax gm))
      (second : Base_Target (Base_Target_Hom D d gx hy)
        (Base_Target_comp D d gx gy hy gm by) (Base_Target_comp D d gx hx hy bx hm)) =>
    Base_Target_eqTrans (Base_Target_Hom D d fx hy)
      (Base_Target_comp D d fx fy hy fm (Base_Target_comp D d fy gy hy ay by))
      (Base_Target_comp D d fx gy hy (Base_Target_comp D d fx fy gy fm ay) by)
      (Base_Target_comp D d fx hx hy (Base_Target_comp D d fx gx hx ax bx) hm)
      (targetEqSymm (Base_Target_Hom D d fx hy)
        (Base_Target_comp D d fx gy hy (Base_Target_comp D d fx fy gy fm ay) by)
        (Base_Target_comp D d fx fy hy fm (Base_Target_comp D d fy gy hy ay by))
        (Base_Target_assoc D d fx fy gy hy fm ay by))
      (Base_Target_eqTrans (Base_Target_Hom D d fx hy)
        (Base_Target_comp D d fx gy hy (Base_Target_comp D d fx fy gy fm ay) by)
        (Base_Target_comp D d fx gy hy (Base_Target_comp D d fx gx gy ax gm) by)
        (Base_Target_comp D d fx hx hy (Base_Target_comp D d fx gx hx ax bx) hm)
        (Base_Target_eqCongr (Base_Target_Hom D d fx gy) (Base_Target_Hom D d fx hy)
          (fun (h : Base_Target_Hom D d fx gy) => Base_Target_comp D d fx gy hy h by)
          (Base_Target_comp D d fx fy gy fm ay) (Base_Target_comp D d fx gx gy ax gm) first)
        (Base_Target_eqTrans (Base_Target_Hom D d fx hy)
          (Base_Target_comp D d fx gy hy (Base_Target_comp D d fx gx gy ax gm) by)
          (Base_Target_comp D d fx gx hy ax (Base_Target_comp D d gx gy hy gm by))
          (Base_Target_comp D d fx hx hy (Base_Target_comp D d fx gx hx ax bx) hm)
          (Base_Target_assoc D d fx gx gy hy ax gm by)
          (Base_Target_eqTrans (Base_Target_Hom D d fx hy)
            (Base_Target_comp D d fx gx hy ax (Base_Target_comp D d gx gy hy gm by))
            (Base_Target_comp D d fx gx hy ax (Base_Target_comp D d gx hx hy bx hm))
            (Base_Target_comp D d fx hx hy (Base_Target_comp D d fx gx hx ax bx) hm)
            (Base_Target_eqCongr (Base_Target_Hom D d gx hy) (Base_Target_Hom D d fx hy)
              (fun (h : Base_Target_Hom D d gx hy) => Base_Target_comp D d fx gx hy ax h)
              (Base_Target_comp D d gx gy hy gm by) (Base_Target_comp D d gx hx hy bx hm) second)
            (targetEqSymm (Base_Target_Hom D d fx hy)
              (Base_Target_comp D d fx hx hy (Base_Target_comp D d fx gx hx ax bx) hm)
              (Base_Target_comp D d fx gx hy ax (Base_Target_comp D d gx hx hy bx hm))
              (Base_Target_assoc D d fx gx hx hy ax bx hm)))))

-- Vertical composition applies alpha first, then beta.
def vcomp : (0 C : Sort (succ u)) -> (0 D : Sort (succ w)) ->
    (c : Base_Source_Category C) -> (d : Base_Target_Category D) ->
    (F : Base_Functor C D c d) -> (G : Base_Functor C D c d) ->
    (H : Base_Functor C D c d) -> NatTrans C D c d F G ->
    NatTrans C D c d G H -> NatTrans C D c d F H :=
  fun (0 C : Sort (succ u)) (0 D : Sort (succ w))
      (c : Base_Source_Category C) (d : Base_Target_Category D)
      (F : Base_Functor C D c d) (G : Base_Functor C D c d) (H : Base_Functor C D c d)
      (alpha : NatTrans C D c d F G) (beta : NatTrans C D c d G H) =>
    ((fun (x : C) =>
       Base_Target_comp D d (F.1 x) (G.1 x) (H.1 x) (alpha.1 x) (beta.1 x)),
     (fun (0 x : C) (0 y : C) (f : Base_Source_Hom C c x y) =>
       vcompLaw D d (F.1 x) (F.1 y) (G.1 x) (G.1 y) (H.1 x) (H.1 y)
         (Base_functorMap C D c d F x y f) (Base_functorMap C D c d G x y f)
         (Base_functorMap C D c d H x y f) (alpha.1 x) (alpha.1 y) (beta.1 x) (beta.1 y)
         (naturality C D c d F G alpha x y f) (naturality C D c d G H beta x y f)))
end

  fun (0 C : Sort (succ u)) (0 D : Sort (succ w)) (0 E : Sort (succ p))
      (c : Base_Source_Category C) (d : Base_Middle_Category D) (e : Base_Target_Category E)

    ((fun (x : C) => Base_Second_functorMap D E d e H (F.1 x) (G.1 x) (alpha.1 x)),
     (fun (0 x : C) (0 y : C) (f : Base_Source_Hom C c x y) =>
       Base_Target_eqTrans (Base_Target_Hom E e (H.1 (F.1 x)) (H.1 (G.1 y)))

           (Base_Second_functorMap D E d e H (F.1 y) (G.1 y) (alpha.1 y)))
         (Base_Second_functorMap D E d e H (F.1 x) (G.1 y)
           (Base_Middle_comp D d (F.1 x) (F.1 y) (G.1 y)
             (Base_First_functorMap C D c d F x y f) (alpha.1 y)))
         (Base_Target_comp E e (H.1 (F.1 x)) (H.1 (G.1 x)) (H.1 (G.1 y))
           (Base_Second_functorMap D E d e H (F.1 x) (G.1 x) (alpha.1 x))
           (Base_Second_functorMap D E d e H (G.1 x) (G.1 y) (Base_First_functorMap C D c d G x y f)))
         (targetEqSymm (Base_Target_Hom E e (H.1 (F.1 x)) (H.1 (G.1 y)))
           (Base_Second_functorMap D E d e H (F.1 x) (G.1 y)
             (Base_Middle_comp D d (F.1 x) (F.1 y) (G.1 y)
               (Base_First_functorMap C D c d F x y f) (alpha.1 y)))
           (Base_Target_comp E e (H.1 (F.1 x)) (H.1 (F.1 y)) (H.1 (G.1 y))
             (Base_Second_functorMap D E d e H (F.1 x) (F.1 y) (Base_First_functorMap C D c d F x y f))
             (Base_Second_functorMap D E d e H (F.1 y) (G.1 y) (alpha.1 y)))
           (Base_Second_functorMapComp D E d e H (F.1 x) (F.1 y) (G.1 y)
             (Base_First_functorMap C D c d F x y f) (alpha.1 y)))
         (Base_Target_eqTrans (Base_Target_Hom E e (H.1 (F.1 x)) (H.1 (G.1 y)))
           (Base_Second_functorMap D E d e H (F.1 x) (G.1 y)
             (Base_Middle_comp D d (F.1 x) (F.1 y) (G.1 y)
               (Base_First_functorMap C D c d F x y f) (alpha.1 y)))
           (Base_Second_functorMap D E d e H (F.1 x) (G.1 y)
             (Base_Middle_comp D d (F.1 x) (G.1 x) (G.1 y)
               (alpha.1 x) (Base_First_functorMap C D c d G x y f)))
           (Base_Target_comp E e (H.1 (F.1 x)) (H.1 (G.1 x)) (H.1 (G.1 y))
             (Base_Second_functorMap D E d e H (F.1 x) (G.1 x) (alpha.1 x))
             (Base_Second_functorMap D E d e H (G.1 x) (G.1 y) (Base_First_functorMap C D c d G x y f)))
           (Base_Second_eqCongr (Base_Middle_Hom D d (F.1 x) (G.1 y))
             (Base_Target_Hom E e (H.1 (F.1 x)) (H.1 (G.1 y)))
             (fun (h : Base_Middle_Hom D d (F.1 x) (G.1 y)) =>
               Base_Second_functorMap D E d e H (F.1 x) (G.1 y) h)
             (Base_Middle_comp D d (F.1 x) (F.1 y) (G.1 y)
               (Base_First_functorMap C D c d F x y f) (alpha.1 y))
             (Base_Middle_comp D d (F.1 x) (G.1 x) (G.1 y)
               (alpha.1 x) (Base_First_functorMap C D c d G x y f))
             (First_naturality C D c d F G alpha x y f))
           (Base_Second_functorMapComp D E d e H (F.1 x) (G.1 x) (G.1 y)
             (alpha.1 x) (Base_First_functorMap C D c d G x y f)))))
end

-- Load category-core, heterogeneous-functor, composable-functors,
-- heterogeneous-nattrans and heterogeneous-whiskering first.
poly (u, v, w, z, p, q) group MechSharedNatTrans where
  specialize MechCategoryCore (u, v) as Source
  specialize MechCategoryCore (w, z) as Middle
  specialize MechCategoryCore (p, q) as Target
  specialize MechHeterogeneousNatTrans (u, v, w, z) as First
    with (Base_Source := Source, Base_Target := Middle)
  specialize MechHeterogeneousNatTrans (w, z, p, q) as Second
    with (Base_Source := Middle, Base_Target := Target)
  specialize MechHeterogeneousNatTrans (u, v, p, q) as Composite
    with (Base_Source := Source, Base_Target := Target)
  specialize MechHeterogeneousWhiskering (u, v, w, z, p, q) as Compose
    with (Base_Source := Source, Base_Middle := Middle, Base_Target := Target)

def hcomp : (0 C : Sort (succ u)) -> (0 D : Sort (succ w)) ->
    (0 E : Sort (succ p)) -> (c : Source_Category C) ->
    (d : Middle_Category D) -> (e : Target_Category E) ->

    (H : Second_Base_Functor D E d e) -> (I : Second_Base_Functor D E d e) ->
    First_NatTrans C D c d F G -> Second_NatTrans D E d e H I ->
    Composite_NatTrans C E c e
      (Compose_Base_compFunctor C D E c d e F H)
      (Compose_Base_compFunctor C D E c d e G I) :=
  fun (0 C : Sort (succ u)) (0 D : Sort (succ w)) (0 E : Sort (succ p))
      (c : Source_Category C) (d : Middle_Category D) (e : Target_Category E)
      (F : First_Base_Functor C D c d) (G : First_Base_Functor C D c d)
      (H : Second_Base_Functor D E d e) (I : Second_Base_Functor D E d e)
      (alpha : First_NatTrans C D c d F G)
      (beta : Second_NatTrans D E d e H I) =>
    Composite_vcomp C E c e
      (Compose_Base_compFunctor C D E c d e F H)
      (Compose_Base_compFunctor C D E c d e G H)
      (Compose_Base_compFunctor C D E c d e G I)
      (Compose_whiskerLeft C D E c d e H F G alpha)
      (Compose_whiskerRight C D E c d e H I beta G)
end

-- Expand the composite maps to avoid rechecking a composed functor here.
-- The generic fixtures check conversion to the existing Composite NatTrans.
def LanCocone : (0 J : Sort (succ u)) -> (0 C : Sort (succ w)) ->
    (0 D : Sort (succ p)) -> (j : Base_Base_Source_Category J) ->
    (c : Base_Base_Middle_Category C) -> (d : Base_Base_Target_Category D) ->
    Base_Base_First_Functor J C j c -> Base_Base_Composite_Functor J D j d ->
    Base_Base_Second_Functor C D c d -> Sort (max (succ u) (succ q)) :=
  fun (0 J : Sort (succ u)) (0 C : Sort (succ w)) (0 D : Sort (succ p))
      (j : Base_Base_Source_Category J) (c : Base_Base_Middle_Category C)
      (d : Base_Base_Target_Category D) (K : Base_Base_First_Functor J C j c)
      (F : Base_Base_Composite_Functor J D j d) (G : Base_Base_Second_Functor C D c d) =>
    (app : (x : J) -> Base_Base_Target_Hom D d (F.1 x) (G.1 (K.1 x))) *
    ((0 x : J) -> (0 y : J) -> (f : Base_Base_Source_Hom J j x y) ->
      Base_Base_Target (Base_Base_Target_Hom D d (F.1 x) (G.1 (K.1 y)))
        (Base_Base_Target_comp D d (F.1 x) (F.1 y) (G.1 (K.1 y))
          (Base_Base_Composite_functorMap J D j d F x y f) (app y))
        (Base_Base_Target_comp D d (F.1 x) (G.1 (K.1 x)) (G.1 (K.1 y))
          (app x) (Base_Base_Second_functorMap C D c d G (K.1 x) (K.1 y)
            (Base_Base_First_functorMap J C j c K x y f))))

    LanCocone J C D j c d K F H -> LanCocone J C D j c d K F G ->
    Base_Second_NatTrans C D c d H G -> Prop :=
  fun (0 J : Sort (succ u)) (0 C : Sort (succ w)) (0 D : Sort (succ p))
      (j : Base_Base_Source_Category J) (c : Base_Base_Middle_Category C) (d : Base_Base_Target_Category D)

      (H : Base_Base_Second_Functor C D c d) (G : Base_Base_Second_Functor C D c d)
      (eta : LanCocone J C D j c d K F H)

      (beta : Base_Second_NatTrans C D c d H G) =>
    (x : J) -> Base_Base_Target (Base_Base_Target_Hom D d (F.1 x) (G.1 (K.1 x)))
      (Base_Base_Target_comp D d (F.1 x) (H.1 (K.1 x)) (G.1 (K.1 x))
        (eta.1 x) (beta.1 (K.1 x))) (alpha.1 x)

    (0 D : Sort (succ p)) -> (j : Base_Base_Source_Category J) -> (c : Base_Base_Middle_Category C) ->
    (d : Base_Base_Target_Category D) -> (K : Base_Base_First_Functor J C j c) -> (F : Base_Base_Composite_Functor J D j d) ->
    (H : Base_Base_Second_Functor C D c d) -> (G : Base_Base_Second_Functor C D c d) ->
    (eta : LanCocone J C D j c d K F H) -> (alpha : LanCocone J C D j c d K F G) ->
    (s : LanSolution J C D j c d K F H G eta alpha) ->
    (beta1 : Base_Second_NatTrans C D c d H G) -> (beta2 : Base_Second_NatTrans C D c d H G) ->
    LanFactor J C D j c d K F H G eta alpha beta1 ->
    LanFactor J C D j c d K F H G eta alpha beta2 ->
    (y : C) -> Base_Base_Target (Base_Base_Target_Hom D d (H.1 y) (G.1 y))
      (beta1.1 y) (beta2.1 y) :=
  fun (0 J : Sort (succ u)) (0 C : Sort (succ w)) (0 D : Sort (succ p))
      (j : Base_Base_Source_Category J) (c : Base_Base_Middle_Category C) (d : Base_Base_Target_Category D)
      (K : Base_Base_First_Functor J C j c) (F : Base_Base_Composite_Functor J D j d) (H : Base_Base_Second_Functor C D c d) (G : Base_Base_Second_Functor C D c d)
      (eta : LanCocone J C D j c d K F H) (alpha : LanCocone J C D j c d K F G)
      (s : LanSolution J C D j c d K F H G eta alpha)

def Alpha : ExternalNat_NatTrans Nat Point IndexedPlain DoubleEnd Constant Constant :=

-- Forget the erased type argument. Every middle arrow has a source lift.
def Forget : ExternalFirst_Functor Nat Nat IndexedEnd IndexedPlain :=

          (0 g : (0 A : Type 0) -> (Path y z) * (Nat -> Nat)) => categoryRefl))))

  ((fun (x : Nat) => point),
   ((fun (0 x : Nat) (0 y : Nat) (f : (Path x y) * (Nat -> Nat)) => (f.2, f.2)),

def forgetUnit : (0 D : Type 1) -> (d : Run_Base_Target_Category D) ->

    Run_Lan_LanCocone Nat Nat D IndexedEnd IndexedPlain d Forget
      (Run_Base_Compose_Base_compFunctor Nat Nat D IndexedEnd IndexedPlain d Forget H) H :=
  fun (0 D : Type 1) (d : Run_Base_Target_Category D)

    ((fun (x : Nat) => Run_Base_Target_id D d (H.1 x)),
     (fun (0 x : Nat) (0 y : Nat) (f : (0 A : Type 0) -> (Path x y) * (Nat -> Nat)) =>

         (Run_Base_Target_comp D d (H.1 x) (H.1 y) (H.1 y)
           (Run_Base_Second_Base_functorMap Nat D IndexedPlain d H x y (f Nat))

         (Run_Base_Second_Base_functorMap Nat D IndexedPlain d H x y (f Nat))
         (Run_Base_Target_comp D d (H.1 x) (H.1 x) (H.1 y)
           (Run_Base_Target_id D d (H.1 x))
           (Run_Base_Second_Base_functorMap Nat D IndexedPlain d H x y (f Nat)))
         (Run_Base_Target_compId D d (H.1 x) (H.1 y)
           (Run_Base_Second_Base_functorMap Nat D IndexedPlain d H x y (f Nat)))
         (Run_Base_Composite_targetEqSymm (Run_Base_Target_Hom D d (H.1 x) (H.1 y))
           (Run_Base_Target_comp D d (H.1 x) (H.1 x) (H.1 y)
             (Run_Base_Target_id D d (H.1 x))
             (Run_Base_Second_Base_functorMap Nat D IndexedPlain d H x y (f Nat)))
           (Run_Base_Second_Base_functorMap Nat D IndexedPlain d H x y (f Nat))
           (Run_Base_Target_idComp D d (H.1 x) (H.1 y)
             (Run_Base_Second_Base_functorMap Nat D IndexedPlain d H x y (f Nat))))))
def forgetLan : (0 D : Type 1) -> (d : Run_Base_Target_Category D) ->
    (H : ExternalSecond_Functor Nat D IndexedPlain d) ->
    Run_Lan_LeftKanExtension Nat Nat D IndexedEnd IndexedPlain d Forget
      (Run_Base_Compose_Base_compFunctor Nat Nat D IndexedEnd IndexedPlain d Forget H) :=
  fun (0 D : Type 1) (d : Run_Base_Target_Category D)
      (H : ExternalSecond_Functor Nat D IndexedPlain d) =>
    (H, (forgetUnit D d H,
     (fun (G : ExternalSecond_Functor Nat D IndexedPlain d)
          (alpha : Run_Lan_LanCocone Nat Nat D IndexedEnd IndexedPlain d Forget
            (Run_Base_Compose_Base_compFunctor Nat Nat D IndexedEnd IndexedPlain d Forget H) G) =>
       ((alpha.1,
         (fun (0 x : Nat) (0 y : Nat) (f : (Path x y) * (Nat -> Nat)) =>
           alpha.2 x y (fun (0 A : Type 0) => f))),
        ((fun (x : Nat) => Run_Base_Target_idComp D d (H.1 x) (G.1 x) (alpha.1 x)),
         (fun (beta : Run_Base_Second_NatTrans Nat D IndexedPlain d H G)
              (h : Run_Lan_LanFactor Nat Nat D IndexedEnd IndexedPlain d Forget
                (Run_Base_Compose_Base_compFunctor Nat Nat D IndexedEnd IndexedPlain d Forget H)
                H G (forgetUnit D d H) alpha beta) (y : Nat) =>
           Run_Base_Target_eqTrans (Run_Base_Target_Hom D d (H.1 y) (G.1 y))
             (beta.1 y)
             (Run_Base_Target_comp D d (H.1 y) (H.1 y) (G.1 y)
               (Run_Base_Target_id D d (H.1 y)) (beta.1 y)) (alpha.1 y)
             (Run_Base_Composite_targetEqSymm (Run_Base_Target_Hom D d (H.1 y) (G.1 y))
               (Run_Base_Target_comp D d (H.1 y) (H.1 y) (G.1 y)
                 (Run_Base_Target_id D d (H.1 y)) (beta.1 y)) (beta.1 y)
               (Run_Base_Target_idComp D d (H.1 y) (G.1 y) (beta.1 y))) (h y)))))))

def postLaw : (y : Nat) -> Run_Base_Target ((Nat -> Nat) * (Nat -> Nat))
    (Run_Base_Target_comp Point DoubleEnd point point point (Mediator.1 y) (Beta.1 y))
    ((PostChosen.1).1 y) :=
