-- Checked data at the first data universe.  No declaration uses the
-- driver's initial Nat axiom or its literal primitives.

mu MechNat : Type 0 with
| mechZero : MechNat
| mechSucc : MechNat -> MechNat

mu MechBool : Type 0 with
| mechFalse : MechBool
| mechTrue : MechBool

mu MechUnit : Type 0 with
| mechUnit : MechUnit

mu MechEmpty : Type 0 with

mu MechFalse : Prop with

mu MechTrue : Prop with
| mechTrivial : MechTrue

mu MechSum (0 A : Type 0) (0 B : Type 0) : Type 0 with
| mechInl : A -> MechSum A B
| mechInr : B -> MechSum A B

mu MechDecidable (0 P : Prop) : Type 0 with
| mechIsFalse : (0 refute : P -> MechFalse) -> MechDecidable P
| mechIsTrue : (0 proof : P) -> MechDecidable P

def MechPi : (0 A : Type 0) -> (0 B : A -> Type 0) -> Type 0 :=
  fun (0 A : Type 0) (0 B : A -> Type 0) => (x : A) -> B x

def MechSigma : (0 A : Type 0) -> (0 B : A -> Type 0) -> Type 0 :=
  fun (0 A : Type 0) (0 B : A -> Type 0) => (x : A) * B x

def mechBoolRec : (0 A : Type 0) -> A -> A -> MechBool -> A :=
  fun (0 A : Type 0) (no : A) (yes : A) (b : MechBool) =>
    case b as self in MechBool return A with
    | mechFalse => no
    | mechTrue => yes

def mechEmptyElim : (0 A : Type 0) -> MechEmpty -> A :=
  fun (0 A : Type 0) (e : MechEmpty) =>
    case e as self in MechEmpty return A with

def mechFalseElim : (0 A : Type 0) -> MechFalse -> A :=
  fun (0 A : Type 0) (e : MechFalse) =>
    case e as self in MechFalse return A with

def mechSumRec : (0 A : Type 0) -> (0 B : Type 0) ->
    (0 C : Type 0) -> (A -> C) -> (B -> C) -> MechSum A B -> C :=
  fun (0 A : Type 0) (0 B : Type 0) (0 C : Type 0)
    (left : A -> C) (right : B -> C) (s : MechSum A B) =>
      case s as self in MechSum return C with
      | mechInl a => left a
      | mechInr b => right b

def rec mechNatRec : (0 P : MechNat -> Type 0) -> P mechZero ->
    ((n : MechNat) -> P n -> P (mechSucc n)) -> (n : MechNat) -> P n :=
  fun (0 P : MechNat -> Type 0) (zero : P mechZero)
    (step : (n : MechNat) -> P n -> P (mechSucc n)) (n : MechNat) =>
      case n as self in MechNat return P self with
      | mechZero => zero
      | mechSucc previous => step previous (mechNatRec P zero step previous)

def mechDecidableBool : (0 P : Prop) -> MechDecidable P -> MechBool :=
  fun (0 P : Prop) (d : MechDecidable P) =>
    case d as self in MechDecidable return MechBool with
    | mechIsFalse 0 refute => mechFalse
    | mechIsTrue 0 proof => mechTrue

-- Equality keeps its endpoints erased and carries no constructor field.
-- The singleton criterion therefore admits elimination into data.
mu MechEq (0 A : Type 0) (0 x : A) : (0 y : A) -> Prop with
| mechReflCtor : MechEq A x x

def mechRefl : (0 A : Type 0) -> (0 x : A) -> MechEq A x x :=
  fun (0 A : Type 0) (0 x : A) => mechReflCtor

def mechJ : (0 A : Type 0) -> (0 x : A) ->
    (0 P : (0 y : A) -> (0 e : MechEq A x y) -> Type 0) ->
    P x (mechRefl A x) -> (0 y : A) -> (e : MechEq A x y) -> P y e :=
  fun (0 A : Type 0) (0 x : A)
    (0 P : (0 y : A) -> (0 e : MechEq A x y) -> Type 0)
    (reflCase : P x (mechRefl A x)) (0 y : A) (e : MechEq A x y) =>
      case e as self in MechEq right return P right self with
      | mechReflCtor => reflCase

def mechTransport : (0 A : Type 0) -> (0 B : A -> Type 0) ->
    (0 x : A) -> (0 y : A) -> MechEq A x y -> B x -> B y :=
  fun (0 A : Type 0) (0 B : A -> Type 0)
    (0 x : A) (0 y : A) (e : MechEq A x y) (value : B x) =>
      mechJ A x (fun (0 right : A) (0 proof : MechEq A x right) => B right)
        value y e

def mechSymm : (0 A : Type 0) -> (0 x : A) -> (0 y : A) ->
    MechEq A x y -> MechEq A y x :=
  fun (0 A : Type 0) (0 x : A) (0 y : A) (e : MechEq A x y) =>
    case e as self in MechEq right return MechEq A right x with
    | mechReflCtor => mechRefl A x

def mechTrans : (0 A : Type 0) -> (0 x : A) -> (0 y : A) -> (0 z : A) ->
    MechEq A x y -> MechEq A y z -> MechEq A x z :=
  fun (0 A : Type 0) (0 x : A) (0 y : A) (0 z : A)
    (first : MechEq A x y) (second : MechEq A y z) =>
      case second as self in MechEq right return MechEq A x right with
      | mechReflCtor => first

def mechCongr : (0 A : Type 0) -> (0 B : Type 0) -> (0 f : A -> B) ->
    (0 x : A) -> (0 y : A) -> MechEq A x y -> MechEq B (f x) (f y) :=
  fun (0 A : Type 0) (0 B : Type 0) (0 f : A -> B)
    (0 x : A) (0 y : A) (e : MechEq A x y) =>
      case e as self in MechEq right return MechEq B (f x) (f right) with
      | mechReflCtor => mechRefl B (f x)

-- The older proof equality has a relevant constructor witness, so it
-- remains an example whose elimination into data is rejected.
mu MechProofEq (0 A : Prop) : (0 x : A) -> (0 y : A) -> Prop with
| mechProofReflCtor : (x : A) -> MechProofEq A x x

def mechProofRefl : (0 A : Prop) -> (x : A) -> MechProofEq A x x :=
  fun (0 A : Prop) (x : A) => mechProofReflCtor x

def mechProofJ : (0 A : Prop) ->
    (0 P : (0 x : A) -> (0 y : A) -> (0 e : MechProofEq A x y) -> Prop) ->
    ((x : A) -> P x x (mechProofRefl A x)) ->
    (0 x : A) -> (0 y : A) -> (e : MechProofEq A x y) -> P x y e :=
  fun (0 A : Prop)
    (0 P : (0 x : A) -> (0 y : A) -> (0 e : MechProofEq A x y) -> Prop)
    (reflCase : (x : A) -> P x x (mechProofRefl A x))
    (0 x : A) (0 y : A) (e : MechProofEq A x y) =>
      case e as self in MechProofEq left right return P left right self with
      | mechProofReflCtor witness => reflCase witness

-- Categories have independent object and morphism Type levels.
-- The equality family and all members specialize together.
poly (u, v) mu MechCategoryCore (0 A : Sort (succ v)) (0 x : A) :
    (0 y : A) -> Prop with
| categoryRefl : MechCategoryCore A x x
where
def Category : (0 Obj : Sort (succ u)) -> Sort (max (succ u) (succ (succ v))) :=
  fun (0 Obj : Sort (succ u)) =>
    (hom : (0 x : Obj) -> (0 y : Obj) -> Sort (succ v)) *
    (identity : (0 x : Obj) -> hom x x) *
    (compose : (0 x : Obj) -> (0 y : Obj) -> (0 z : Obj) ->
      hom x y -> hom y z -> hom x z) *
    (left : (0 x : Obj) -> (0 y : Obj) -> (0 f : hom x y) ->
      MechCategoryCore (hom x y) (compose x x y (identity x) f) f) *
    (right : (0 x : Obj) -> (0 y : Obj) -> (0 f : hom x y) ->
      MechCategoryCore (hom x y) (compose x y y f (identity y)) f) *
    ((0 w : Obj) -> (0 x : Obj) -> (0 y : Obj) -> (0 z : Obj) ->
      (0 f : hom w x) -> (0 g : hom x y) -> (0 h : hom y z) ->
      MechCategoryCore (hom w z)
        (compose w y z (compose w x y f g) h)
        (compose w x z f (compose x y z g h)))

def Hom : (0 Obj : Sort (succ u)) -> (category : Category Obj) ->
    (0 x : Obj) -> (0 y : Obj) -> Sort (succ v) :=
  fun (0 Obj : Sort (succ u)) (category : Category Obj) => category.1

def id : (0 Obj : Sort (succ u)) -> (category : Category Obj) ->
    (0 x : Obj) -> Hom Obj category x x :=
  fun (0 Obj : Sort (succ u)) (category : Category Obj) => category.2.1

def comp : (0 Obj : Sort (succ u)) -> (category : Category Obj) ->
    (0 x : Obj) -> (0 y : Obj) -> (0 z : Obj) ->
    Hom Obj category x y -> Hom Obj category y z -> Hom Obj category x z :=
  fun (0 Obj : Sort (succ u)) (category : Category Obj) => category.2.2.1

def idComp : (0 Obj : Sort (succ u)) -> (category : Category Obj) ->
    (0 x : Obj) -> (0 y : Obj) -> (0 f : Hom Obj category x y) ->
    MechCategoryCore (Hom Obj category x y) (comp Obj category x x y (id Obj category x) f) f :=
  fun (0 Obj : Sort (succ u)) (category : Category Obj) => category.2.2.2.1

def compId : (0 Obj : Sort (succ u)) -> (category : Category Obj) ->
    (0 x : Obj) -> (0 y : Obj) -> (0 f : Hom Obj category x y) ->
    MechCategoryCore (Hom Obj category x y) (comp Obj category x y y f (id Obj category y)) f :=
  fun (0 Obj : Sort (succ u)) (category : Category Obj) => category.2.2.2.2.1

def assoc : (0 Obj : Sort (succ u)) -> (category : Category Obj) ->
    (0 w : Obj) -> (0 x : Obj) -> (0 y : Obj) -> (0 z : Obj) ->
    (0 f : Hom Obj category w x) -> (0 g : Hom Obj category x y) ->
    (0 h : Hom Obj category y z) ->
    MechCategoryCore (Hom Obj category w z)

      (comp Obj category w x z f (comp Obj category x y z g h)) :=
  fun (0 Obj : Sort (succ u)) (category : Category Obj) => category.2.2.2.2.2

-- Equality operations retain this group's nominal equality family.
def eqTrans : (0 A : Sort (succ v)) -> (0 x : A) -> (0 y : A) ->
    (0 z : A) -> MechCategoryCore A x y -> MechCategoryCore A y z -> MechCategoryCore A x z :=
  fun (0 A : Sort (succ v)) (0 x : A) (0 y : A) (0 z : A)
      (first : MechCategoryCore A x y) (second : MechCategoryCore A y z) =>
    match second as self in MechCategoryCore right return MechCategoryCore A x right with
    | categoryRefl => first

def eqCongr : (0 A : Sort (succ v)) -> (0 B : Sort (succ v)) ->
    (0 f : A -> B) -> (0 x : A) -> (0 y : A) ->
    MechCategoryCore A x y -> MechCategoryCore B (f x) (f y) :=
  fun (0 A : Sort (succ v)) (0 B : Sort (succ v)) (0 f : A -> B)

    match proof as self in MechCategoryCore right return MechCategoryCore B (f x) (f right) with
    | categoryRefl => categoryRefl

    (mapId : (0 x : C) -> Target (Target_Hom D d (obj x) (obj x))

      (functorMap C D c d F x x (Source_id C c x)) (Target_id D d (F.1 x)) :=
  fun (0 C : Sort (succ u)) (0 D : Sort (succ w))
      (c : Source_Category C) (d : Target_Category D) (F : Functor C D c d) => F.2.2.1

def functorMapComp : (0 C : Sort (succ u)) -> (0 D : Sort (succ w)) ->
    (c : Source_Category C) -> (d : Target_Category D) -> (F : Functor C D c d) ->

    Target (Target_Hom D d (F.1 x) (F.1 z))
      (functorMap C D c d F x z (Source_comp C c x y z f g))
      (Target_comp D d (F.1 x) (F.1 y) (F.1 z)
        (functorMap C D c d F x y f) (functorMap C D c d F y z g)) :=
  fun (0 C : Sort (succ u)) (0 D : Sort (succ w))
      (c : Source_Category C) (d : Target_Category D) (F : Functor C D c d) => F.2.2.2

-- Congruence crosses both the universe and nominal equality boundary.
def eqCongr : (0 A : Sort (succ v)) -> (0 B : Sort (succ z)) ->

      (c : Source_Category C) (d : Middle_Category D) =>

def compFunctor : (0 C : Sort (succ u)) -> (0 D : Sort (succ w)) ->
    (0 E : Sort (succ p)) -> (c : Source_Category C) -> (d : Middle_Category D) ->
    (e : Target_Category E) -> First_Functor C D c d -> Second_Functor D E d e -> Composite_Functor C E c e :=
  fun (0 C : Sort (succ u)) (0 D : Sort (succ w)) (0 E : Sort (succ p))
      (c : Source_Category C) (d : Middle_Category D) (e : Target_Category E)
      (F : First_Functor C D c d) (G : Second_Functor D E d e) =>
    ((fun (x : C) => G.1 (F.1 x)),
     ((fun (0 x : C) (0 y : C) (f : Source_Hom C c x y) =>
         Second_functorMap D E d e G (F.1 x) (F.1 y) (First_functorMap C D c d F x y f)),

          Target_eqTrans (Target_Hom E e (G.1 (F.1 x)) (G.1 (F.1 x)))

              (First_functorMap C D c d F x x (Source_id C c x)))
            (Second_functorMap D E d e G (F.1 x) (F.1 x) (Middle_id D d (F.1 x)))

            (Second_eqCongr (Middle_Hom D d (F.1 x) (F.1 x))
              (Target_Hom E e (G.1 (F.1 x)) (G.1 (F.1 x)))
              (fun (h : Middle_Hom D d (F.1 x) (F.1 x)) =>
                Second_functorMap D E d e G (F.1 x) (F.1 x) h)
              (First_functorMap C D c d F x x (Source_id C c x)) (Middle_id D d (F.1 x))
              (First_functorMapId C D c d F x))
            (Second_functorMapId D E d e G (F.1 x))),
       (fun (0 x : C) (0 y : C) (0 z : C)
            (0 f : Source_Hom C c x y) (0 g : Source_Hom C c y z) =>
          Target_eqTrans (Target_Hom E e (G.1 (F.1 x)) (G.1 (F.1 z)))
            (Second_functorMap D E d e G (F.1 x) (F.1 z)
              (First_functorMap C D c d F x z (Source_comp C c x y z f g)))
            (Second_functorMap D E d e G (F.1 x) (F.1 z)
              (Middle_comp D d (F.1 x) (F.1 y) (F.1 z)
                (First_functorMap C D c d F x y f) (First_functorMap C D c d F y z g)))
            (Target_comp E e (G.1 (F.1 x)) (G.1 (F.1 y)) (G.1 (F.1 z))
              (Second_functorMap D E d e G (F.1 x) (F.1 y) (First_functorMap C D c d F x y f))
              (Second_functorMap D E d e G (F.1 y) (F.1 z) (First_functorMap C D c d F y z g)))
            (Second_eqCongr (Middle_Hom D d (F.1 x) (F.1 z))
              (Target_Hom E e (G.1 (F.1 x)) (G.1 (F.1 z)))
              (fun (h : Middle_Hom D d (F.1 x) (F.1 z)) =>
                Second_functorMap D E d e G (F.1 x) (F.1 z) h)
              (First_functorMap C D c d F x z (Source_comp C c x y z f g))
              (Middle_comp D d (F.1 x) (F.1 y) (F.1 z)
                (First_functorMap C D c d F x y f) (First_functorMap C D c d F y z g))
              (First_functorMapComp C D c d F x y z f g))
            (Second_functorMapComp D E d e G (F.1 x) (F.1 y) (F.1 z)
              (First_functorMap C D c d F x y f) (First_functorMap C D c d F y z g))))))

-- Load category-core.mech and heterogeneous-functor.mech first.
-- Both functors share one source and one target category instance.

specialize MechHeterogeneousFunctor (u, v, w, z) as Base

def targetEqSymm : (0 A : Sort (succ z)) -> (0 x : A) -> (0 y : A) ->
    Base_Target A x y -> Base_Target A y x :=
  fun (0 A : Sort (succ z)) (0 x : A) (0 y : A)
      (proof : Base_Target A x y) =>
    match proof as self in Base_Target right return Base_Target A right x with
    | categoryRefl => categoryRefl

-- Components can inspect their object.  The naturality field erases.
-- A naturality proof can inspect its morphism during proof construction.
def NatTrans : (0 C : Sort (succ u)) -> (0 D : Sort (succ w)) ->
    (c : Base_Source_Category C) -> (d : Base_Target_Category D) ->
    Base_Functor C D c d -> Base_Functor C D c d -> Sort (max (succ u) (succ z)) :=
  fun (0 C : Sort (succ u)) (0 D : Sort (succ w))
      (c : Base_Source_Category C) (d : Base_Target_Category D)
      (F : Base_Functor C D c d) (G : Base_Functor C D c d) =>
    (app : (x : C) -> Base_Target_Hom D d (F.1 x) (G.1 x)) *
    ((0 x : C) -> (0 y : C) -> (f : Base_Source_Hom C c x y) ->
      Base_Target (Base_Target_Hom D d (F.1 x) (G.1 y))
        (Base_Target_comp D d (F.1 x) (F.1 y) (G.1 y)
          (Base_functorMap C D c d F x y f) (app y))
        (Base_Target_comp D d (F.1 x) (G.1 x) (G.1 y)
          (app x) (Base_functorMap C D c d G x y f)))

def natApp : (0 C : Sort (succ u)) -> (0 D : Sort (succ w)) ->
    (c : Base_Source_Category C) -> (d : Base_Target_Category D) ->
    (F : Base_Functor C D c d) -> (G : Base_Functor C D c d) ->
    NatTrans C D c d F G -> (x : C) -> Base_Target_Hom D d (F.1 x) (G.1 x) :=
  fun (0 C : Sort (succ u)) (0 D : Sort (succ w))
      (c : Base_Source_Category C) (d : Base_Target_Category D)
      (F : Base_Functor C D c d) (G : Base_Functor C D c d)
      (alpha : NatTrans C D c d F G) => alpha.1

def naturality : (0 C : Sort (succ u)) -> (0 D : Sort (succ w)) ->
    (c : Base_Source_Category C) -> (d : Base_Target_Category D) ->
    (F : Base_Functor C D c d) -> (G : Base_Functor C D c d) ->
    (alpha : NatTrans C D c d F G) ->
    (0 x : C) -> (0 y : C) -> (f : Base_Source_Hom C c x y) ->
    Base_Target (Base_Target_Hom D d (F.1 x) (G.1 y))
      (Base_Target_comp D d (F.1 x) (F.1 y) (G.1 y)
        (Base_functorMap C D c d F x y f) (alpha.1 y))
      (Base_Target_comp D d (F.1 x) (G.1 x) (G.1 y)
        (alpha.1 x) (Base_functorMap C D c d G x y f)) :=
  fun (0 C : Sort (succ u)) (0 D : Sort (succ w))
      (c : Base_Source_Category C) (d : Base_Target_Category D)
      (F : Base_Functor C D c d) (G : Base_Functor C D c d)
      (alpha : NatTrans C D c d F G) => alpha.2

def idNat : (0 C : Sort (succ u)) -> (0 D : Sort (succ w)) ->
    (c : Base_Source_Category C) -> (d : Base_Target_Category D) ->
    (F : Base_Functor C D c d) -> NatTrans C D c d F F :=
  fun (0 C : Sort (succ u)) (0 D : Sort (succ w))
      (c : Base_Source_Category C) (d : Base_Target_Category D) (F : Base_Functor C D c d) =>
    ((fun (x : C) => Base_Target_id D d (F.1 x)),
     (fun (0 x : C) (0 y : C) (f : Base_Source_Hom C c x y) =>
       Base_Target_eqTrans (Base_Target_Hom D d (F.1 x) (F.1 y))
       (Base_Target_comp D d (F.1 x) (F.1 y) (F.1 y) (Base_functorMap C D c d F x y f) (Base_Target_id D d (F.1 y)))
       (Base_functorMap C D c d F x y f)
       (Base_Target_comp D d (F.1 x) (F.1 x) (F.1 y) (Base_Target_id D d (F.1 x)) (Base_functorMap C D c d F x y f))
       (Base_Target_compId D d (F.1 x) (F.1 y) (Base_functorMap C D c d F x y f))
       (targetEqSymm (Base_Target_Hom D d (F.1 x) (F.1 y))
       (Base_Target_comp D d (F.1 x) (F.1 x) (F.1 y) (Base_Target_id D d (F.1 x)) (Base_functorMap C D c d F x y f))
       (Base_functorMap C D c d F x y f) (Base_Target_idComp D d (F.1 x) (F.1 y) (Base_functorMap C D c d F x y f)))))

-- Two naturality squares compose using the category laws.
def vcompLaw : (0 D : Sort (succ w)) -> (d : Base_Target_Category D) ->
    (0 fx : D) -> (0 fy : D) -> (0 gx : D) -> (0 gy : D) -> (0 hx : D) -> (0 hy : D) ->
    (0 fm : Base_Target_Hom D d fx fy) -> (0 gm : Base_Target_Hom D d gx gy) -> (0 hm : Base_Target_Hom D d hx hy) ->
    (0 ax : Base_Target_Hom D d fx gx) -> (0 ay : Base_Target_Hom D d fy gy) ->
    (0 bx : Base_Target_Hom D d gx hx) -> (0 by : Base_Target_Hom D d gy hy) ->
    Base_Target (Base_Target_Hom D d fx gy) (Base_Target_comp D d fx fy gy fm ay) (Base_Target_comp D d fx gx gy ax gm) ->
    Base_Target (Base_Target_Hom D d gx hy) (Base_Target_comp D d gx gy hy gm by) (Base_Target_comp D d gx hx hy bx hm) ->
    Base_Target (Base_Target_Hom D d fx hy)
      (Base_Target_comp D d fx fy hy fm (Base_Target_comp D d fy gy hy ay by))
      (Base_Target_comp D d fx hx hy (Base_Target_comp D d fx gx hx ax bx) hm) :=
  fun (0 D : Sort (succ w)) (d : Base_Target_Category D)
      (0 fx : D) (0 fy : D) (0 gx : D) (0 gy : D) (0 hx : D) (0 hy : D)
      (0 fm : Base_Target_Hom D d fx fy) (0 gm : Base_Target_Hom D d gx gy) (0 hm : Base_Target_Hom D d hx hy)
      (0 ax : Base_Target_Hom D d fx gx) (0 ay : Base_Target_Hom D d fy gy)
      (0 bx : Base_Target_Hom D d gx hx) (0 by : Base_Target_Hom D d gy hy)
      (first : Base_Target (Base_Target_Hom D d fx gy)
        (Base_Target_comp D d fx fy gy fm ay) (Base_Target_comp D d fx gx gy ax gm))
      (second : Base_Target (Base_Target_Hom D d gx hy)
        (Base_Target_comp D d gx gy hy gm by) (Base_Target_comp D d gx hx hy bx hm)) =>
    Base_Target_eqTrans (Base_Target_Hom D d fx hy)
      (Base_Target_comp D d fx fy hy fm (Base_Target_comp D d fy gy hy ay by))
      (Base_Target_comp D d fx gy hy (Base_Target_comp D d fx fy gy fm ay) by)
      (Base_Target_comp D d fx hx hy (Base_Target_comp D d fx gx hx ax bx) hm)
      (targetEqSymm (Base_Target_Hom D d fx hy)
        (Base_Target_comp D d fx gy hy (Base_Target_comp D d fx fy gy fm ay) by)
        (Base_Target_comp D d fx fy hy fm (Base_Target_comp D d fy gy hy ay by))
        (Base_Target_assoc D d fx fy gy hy fm ay by))
      (Base_Target_eqTrans (Base_Target_Hom D d fx hy)
        (Base_Target_comp D d fx gy hy (Base_Target_comp D d fx fy gy fm ay) by)
        (Base_Target_comp D d fx gy hy (Base_Target_comp D d fx gx gy ax gm) by)
        (Base_Target_comp D d fx hx hy (Base_Target_comp D d fx gx hx ax bx) hm)
        (Base_Target_eqCongr (Base_Target_Hom D d fx gy) (Base_Target_Hom D d fx hy)
          (fun (h : Base_Target_Hom D d fx gy) => Base_Target_comp D d fx gy hy h by)
          (Base_Target_comp D d fx fy gy fm ay) (Base_Target_comp D d fx gx gy ax gm) first)
        (Base_Target_eqTrans (Base_Target_Hom D d fx hy)
          (Base_Target_comp D d fx gy hy (Base_Target_comp D d fx gx gy ax gm) by)
          (Base_Target_comp D d fx gx hy ax (Base_Target_comp D d gx gy hy gm by))
          (Base_Target_comp D d fx hx hy (Base_Target_comp D d fx gx hx ax bx) hm)
          (Base_Target_assoc D d fx gx gy hy ax gm by)
          (Base_Target_eqTrans (Base_Target_Hom D d fx hy)
            (Base_Target_comp D d fx gx hy ax (Base_Target_comp D d gx gy hy gm by))

def LanFactor : (0 J : Sort (succ u)) -> (0 C : Sort (succ w)) ->

    (d : Base_Base_Target_Category D) -> (K : Base_Base_First_Functor J C j c) -> (F : Base_Base_Composite_Functor J D j d) ->

    LanCocone J C D j c d K F H -> LanCocone J C D j c d K F G ->
    Base_Second_NatTrans C D c d H G -> Prop :=
  fun (0 J : Sort (succ u)) (0 C : Sort (succ w)) (0 D : Sort (succ p))
      (j : Base_Base_Source_Category J) (c : Base_Base_Middle_Category C) (d : Base_Base_Target_Category D)
      (K : Base_Base_First_Functor J C j c) (F : Base_Base_Composite_Functor J D j d)
      (H : Base_Base_Second_Functor C D c d) (G : Base_Base_Second_Functor C D c d)

def desc_unique : (0 J : Sort (succ u)) -> (0 C : Sort (succ w)) ->
    (0 D : Sort (succ p)) -> (j : Base_Base_Source_Category J) -> (c : Base_Base_Middle_Category C) ->
    (d : Base_Base_Target_Category D) -> (K : Base_Base_First_Functor J C j c) -> (F : Base_Base_Composite_Functor J D j d) ->
    (H : Base_Base_Second_Functor C D c d) -> (G : Base_Base_Second_Functor C D c d) ->
    (eta : LanCocone J C D j c d K F H) -> (alpha : LanCocone J C D j c d K F G) ->
    (s : LanSolution J C D j c d K F H G eta alpha) ->
    (beta1 : Base_Second_NatTrans C D c d H G) -> (beta2 : Base_Second_NatTrans C D c d H G) ->
    LanFactor J C D j c d K F H G eta alpha beta1 ->
    LanFactor J C D j c d K F H G eta alpha beta2 ->
    (y : C) -> Base_Base_Target (Base_Base_Target_Hom D d (H.1 y) (G.1 y))
      (beta1.1 y) (beta2.1 y) :=
  fun (0 J : Sort (succ u)) (0 C : Sort (succ w)) (0 D : Sort (succ p))
      (j : Base_Base_Source_Category J) (c : Base_Base_Middle_Category C) (d : Base_Base_Target_Category D)
      (K : Base_Base_First_Functor J C j c) (F : Base_Base_Composite_Functor J D j d) (H : Base_Base_Second_Functor C D c d) (G : Base_Base_Second_Functor C D c d)
      (eta : LanCocone J C D j c d K F H) (alpha : LanCocone J C D j c d K F G)
      (s : LanSolution J C D j c d K F H G eta alpha)
      (beta1 : Base_Second_NatTrans C D c d H G) (beta2 : Base_Second_NatTrans C D c d H G)
      (h1 : LanFactor J C D j c d K F H G eta alpha beta1)
      (h2 : LanFactor J C D j c d K F H G eta alpha beta2) (y : C) =>
    Base_Base_Target_eqTrans (Base_Base_Target_Hom D d (H.1 y) (G.1 y))
      (beta1.1 y) ((s.1).1 y) (beta2.1 y)
      (lanUniq J C D j c d K F H G eta alpha s beta1 h1 y)
      (Base_targetEqSymm (Base_Base_Target_Hom D d (H.1 y) (G.1 y)) (beta2.1 y) ((s.1).1 y)
        (lanUniq J C D j c d K F H G eta alpha s beta2 h2 y))
end

-- Equality keeps its endpoints erased and carries no constructor field.
-- The singleton criterion therefore admits elimination into data.
mu MechEq (0 A : Type 0) (0 x : A) : (0 y : A) -> Prop with
| mechReflCtor : MechEq A x x

def mechRefl : (0 A : Type 0) -> (0 x : A) -> MechEq A x x :=
  fun (0 A : Type 0) (0 x : A) => mechReflCtor

def mechJ : (0 A : Type 0) -> (0 x : A) ->
    (0 P : (0 y : A) -> (0 e : MechEq A x y) -> Type 0) ->
    P x (mechRefl A x) -> (0 y : A) -> (e : MechEq A x y) -> P y e :=
  fun (0 A : Type 0) (0 x : A)
    (0 P : (0 y : A) -> (0 e : MechEq A x y) -> Type 0)
    (reflCase : P x (mechRefl A x)) (0 y : A) (e : MechEq A x y) =>
      case e as self in MechEq right return P right self with
      | mechReflCtor => reflCase

def mechTransport : (0 A : Type 0) -> (0 B : A -> Type 0) ->
    (0 x : A) -> (0 y : A) -> MechEq A x y -> B x -> B y :=
  fun (0 A : Type 0) (0 B : A -> Type 0)
    (0 x : A) (0 y : A) (e : MechEq A x y) (value : B x) =>
      mechJ A x (fun (0 right : A) (0 proof : MechEq A x right) => B right)
        value y e

  fun (0 A : Type 0) (0 x : A) (0 y : A) (e : MechEq A x y) =>
    case e as self in MechEq right return MechEq A right x with
    | mechReflCtor => mechRefl A x

    MechEq A x y -> MechEq A y z -> MechEq A x z :=
  fun (0 A : Type 0) (0 x : A) (0 y : A) (0 z : A)
    (first : MechEq A x y) (second : MechEq A y z) =>
      case second as self in MechEq right return MechEq A x right with
      | mechReflCtor => first

  fun (0 A : Type 0) (0 B : Type 0) (0 f : A -> B)
    (0 x : A) (0 y : A) (e : MechEq A x y) =>

-- remains an example whose elimination into data is rejected.
mu MechProofEq (0 A : Prop) : (0 x : A) -> (0 y : A) -> Prop with

    (0 P : (0 x : A) -> (0 y : A) -> (0 e : MechProofEq A x y) -> Prop) ->
    ((x : A) -> P x x (mechProofRefl A x)) ->

  fun (0 A : Prop)

    (reflCase : (x : A) -> P x x (mechProofRefl A x))

      case e as self in MechProofEq left right return P left right self with
      | mechProofReflCtor witness => reflCase witness

def Category : (0 Obj : Sort (succ u)) -> Sort (max (succ u) (succ (succ v))) :=
  fun (0 Obj : Sort (succ u)) =>
    (hom : (0 x : Obj) -> (0 y : Obj) -> Sort (succ v)) *
    (identity : (0 x : Obj) -> hom x x) *
    (compose : (0 x : Obj) -> (0 y : Obj) -> (0 z : Obj) ->
      hom x y -> hom y z -> hom x z) *
    (left : (0 x : Obj) -> (0 y : Obj) -> (0 f : hom x y) ->
      MechCategoryCore (hom x y) (compose x x y (identity x) f) f) *
    (right : (0 x : Obj) -> (0 y : Obj) -> (0 f : hom x y) ->
      MechCategoryCore (hom x y) (compose x y y f (identity y)) f) *
    ((0 w : Obj) -> (0 x : Obj) -> (0 y : Obj) -> (0 z : Obj) ->
      (0 f : hom w x) -> (0 g : hom x y) -> (0 h : hom y z) ->
      MechCategoryCore (hom w z)

        (compose w x z f (compose x y z g h)))

                Second_functorMap D E d e G (F.1 x) (F.1 x) h)

            (Second_functorMap D E d e G (F.1 x) (F.1 z)
              (First_functorMap C D c d F x z (Source_comp C c x y z f g)))
            (Second_functorMap D E d e G (F.1 x) (F.1 z)
              (Middle_comp D d (F.1 x) (F.1 y) (F.1 z)
                (First_functorMap C D c d F x y f) (First_functorMap C D c d F y z g)))
            (Target_comp E e (G.1 (F.1 x)) (G.1 (F.1 y)) (G.1 (F.1 z))
              (Second_functorMap D E d e G (F.1 x) (F.1 y) (First_functorMap C D c d F x y f))
              (Second_functorMap D E d e G (F.1 y) (F.1 z) (First_functorMap C D c d F y z g)))
            (Second_eqCongr (Middle_Hom D d (F.1 x) (F.1 z))

            (Second_functorMapComp D E d e G (F.1 x) (F.1 y) (F.1 z)

-- Components can inspect their object.  The naturality field erases.

def vcompLaw : (0 D : Sort (succ w)) -> (d : Base_Target_Category D) ->
    (0 fx : D) -> (0 fy : D) -> (0 gx : D) -> (0 gy : D) -> (0 hx : D) -> (0 hy : D) ->
    (0 fm : Base_Target_Hom D d fx fy) -> (0 gm : Base_Target_Hom D d gx gy) -> (0 hm : Base_Target_Hom D d hx hy) ->
    (0 ax : Base_Target_Hom D d fx gx) -> (0 ay : Base_Target_Hom D d fy gy) ->
    (0 bx : Base_Target_Hom D d gx hx) -> (0 by : Base_Target_Hom D d gy hy) ->
    Base_Target (Base_Target_Hom D d fx gy) (Base_Target_comp D d fx fy gy fm ay) (Base_Target_comp D d fx gx gy ax gm) ->
    Base_Target (Base_Target_Hom D d gx hy) (Base_Target_comp D d gx gy hy gm by) (Base_Target_comp D d gx hx hy bx hm) ->
    Base_Target (Base_Target_Hom D d fx hy)
      (Base_Target_comp D d fx fy hy fm (Base_Target_comp D d fy gy hy ay by))
      (Base_Target_comp D d fx hx hy (Base_Target_comp D d fx gx hx ax bx) hm) :=
  fun (0 D : Sort (succ w)) (d : Base_Target_Category D)
      (0 fx : D) (0 fy : D) (0 gx : D) (0 gy : D) (0 hx : D) (0 hy : D)
      (0 fm : Base_Target_Hom D d fx fy) (0 gm : Base_Target_Hom D d gx gy) (0 hm : Base_Target_Hom D d hx hy)
      (0 ax : Base_Target_Hom D d fx gx) (0 ay : Base_Target_Hom D d fy gy)
      (0 bx : Base_Target_Hom D d gx hx) (0 by : Base_Target_Hom D d gy hy)
      (first : Base_Target (Base_Target_Hom D d fx gy)
        (Base_Target_comp D d fx fy gy fm ay) (Base_Target_comp D d fx gx gy ax gm))
      (second : Base_Target (Base_Target_Hom D d gx hy)
        (Base_Target_comp D d gx gy hy gm by) (Base_Target_comp D d gx hx hy bx hm)) =>
    Base_Target_eqTrans (Base_Target_Hom D d fx hy)
      (Base_Target_comp D d fx fy hy fm (Base_Target_comp D d fy gy hy ay by))
      (Base_Target_comp D d fx gy hy (Base_Target_comp D d fx fy gy fm ay) by)
      (Base_Target_comp D d fx hx hy (Base_Target_comp D d fx gx hx ax bx) hm)
      (targetEqSymm (Base_Target_Hom D d fx hy)
        (Base_Target_comp D d fx gy hy (Base_Target_comp D d fx fy gy fm ay) by)
        (Base_Target_comp D d fx fy hy fm (Base_Target_comp D d fy gy hy ay by))
        (Base_Target_assoc D d fx fy gy hy fm ay by))
      (Base_Target_eqTrans (Base_Target_Hom D d fx hy)
        (Base_Target_comp D d fx gy hy (Base_Target_comp D d fx fy gy fm ay) by)
        (Base_Target_comp D d fx gy hy (Base_Target_comp D d fx gx gy ax gm) by)
        (Base_Target_comp D d fx hx hy (Base_Target_comp D d fx gx hx ax bx) hm)
        (Base_Target_eqCongr (Base_Target_Hom D d fx gy) (Base_Target_Hom D d fx hy)
          (fun (h : Base_Target_Hom D d fx gy) => Base_Target_comp D d fx gy hy h by)
          (Base_Target_comp D d fx fy gy fm ay) (Base_Target_comp D d fx gx gy ax gm) first)
        (Base_Target_eqTrans (Base_Target_Hom D d fx hy)
          (Base_Target_comp D d fx gy hy (Base_Target_comp D d fx gx gy ax gm) by)
          (Base_Target_comp D d fx gx hy ax (Base_Target_comp D d gx gy hy gm by))
          (Base_Target_comp D d fx hx hy (Base_Target_comp D d fx gx hx ax bx) hm)
          (Base_Target_assoc D d fx gx gy hy ax gm by)
          (Base_Target_eqTrans (Base_Target_Hom D d fx hy)
            (Base_Target_comp D d fx gx hy ax (Base_Target_comp D d gx gy hy gm by))
            (Base_Target_comp D d fx gx hy ax (Base_Target_comp D d gx hx hy bx hm))
            (Base_Target_comp D d fx hx hy (Base_Target_comp D d fx gx hx ax bx) hm)
            (Base_Target_eqCongr (Base_Target_Hom D d gx hy) (Base_Target_Hom D d fx hy)
              (fun (h : Base_Target_Hom D d gx hy) => Base_Target_comp D d fx gx hy ax h)
              (Base_Target_comp D d gx gy hy gm by) (Base_Target_comp D d gx hx hy bx hm) second)
            (targetEqSymm (Base_Target_Hom D d fx hy)
              (Base_Target_comp D d fx hx hy (Base_Target_comp D d fx gx hx ax bx) hm)
              (Base_Target_comp D d fx gx hy ax (Base_Target_comp D d gx hx hy bx hm))
              (Base_Target_assoc D d fx gx hx hy ax bx hm)))))

-- Vertical composition applies alpha first, then beta.
def vcomp : (0 C : Sort (succ u)) -> (0 D : Sort (succ w)) ->
    (c : Base_Source_Category C) -> (d : Base_Target_Category D) ->
    (F : Base_Functor C D c d) -> (G : Base_Functor C D c d) ->
    (H : Base_Functor C D c d) -> NatTrans C D c d F G ->
    NatTrans C D c d G H -> NatTrans C D c d F H :=
  fun (0 C : Sort (succ u)) (0 D : Sort (succ w))
      (c : Base_Source_Category C) (d : Base_Target_Category D)
      (F : Base_Functor C D c d) (G : Base_Functor C D c d) (H : Base_Functor C D c d)
      (alpha : NatTrans C D c d F G) (beta : NatTrans C D c d G H) =>
    ((fun (x : C) =>
       Base_Target_comp D d (F.1 x) (G.1 x) (H.1 x) (alpha.1 x) (beta.1 x)),
     (fun (0 x : C) (0 y : C) (f : Base_Source_Hom C c x y) =>
       vcompLaw D d (F.1 x) (F.1 y) (G.1 x) (G.1 y) (H.1 x) (H.1 y)
         (Base_functorMap C D c d F x y f) (Base_functorMap C D c d G x y f)
         (Base_functorMap C D c d H x y f) (alpha.1 x) (alpha.1 y) (beta.1 x) (beta.1 y)
         (naturality C D c d F G alpha x y f) (naturality C D c d G H beta x y f)))
end

| mechInr : B -> MechSum A B

| mechIsFalse : (0 refute : P -> MechFalse) -> MechDecidable P
| mechIsTrue : (0 proof : P) -> MechDecidable P

def MechPi : (0 A : Type 0) -> (0 B : A -> Type 0) -> Type 0 :=
  fun (0 A : Type 0) (0 B : A -> Type 0) => (x : A) -> B x

def MechSigma : (0 A : Type 0) -> (0 B : A -> Type 0) -> Type 0 :=
  fun (0 A : Type 0) (0 B : A -> Type 0) => (x : A) * B x

def mechBoolRec : (0 A : Type 0) -> A -> A -> MechBool -> A :=
  fun (0 A : Type 0) (no : A) (yes : A) (b : MechBool) =>
    case b as self in MechBool return A with
    | mechFalse => no
    | mechTrue => yes

def mechEmptyElim : (0 A : Type 0) -> MechEmpty -> A :=
  fun (0 A : Type 0) (e : MechEmpty) =>
    case e as self in MechEmpty return A with

def mechFalseElim : (0 A : Type 0) -> MechFalse -> A :=
  fun (0 A : Type 0) (e : MechFalse) =>
    case e as self in MechFalse return A with

def mechSumRec : (0 A : Type 0) -> (0 B : Type 0) ->
    (0 C : Type 0) -> (A -> C) -> (B -> C) -> MechSum A B -> C :=
  fun (0 A : Type 0) (0 B : Type 0) (0 C : Type 0)
    (left : A -> C) (right : B -> C) (s : MechSum A B) =>
      case s as self in MechSum return C with
      | mechInl a => left a
      | mechInr b => right b

def rec mechNatRec : (0 P : MechNat -> Type 0) -> P mechZero ->
    ((n : MechNat) -> P n -> P (mechSucc n)) -> (n : MechNat) -> P n :=
  fun (0 P : MechNat -> Type 0) (zero : P mechZero)
    (step : (n : MechNat) -> P n -> P (mechSucc n)) (n : MechNat) =>
      case n as self in MechNat return P self with
      | mechZero => zero
      | mechSucc previous => step previous (mechNatRec P zero step previous)

def mechDecidableBool : (0 P : Prop) -> MechDecidable P -> MechBool :=
  fun (0 P : Prop) (d : MechDecidable P) =>

-- Equality keeps its endpoints erased and carries no constructor field.
-- The singleton criterion therefore admits elimination into data.
mu MechEq (0 A : Type 0) (0 x : A) : (0 y : A) -> Prop with
| mechReflCtor : MechEq A x x

def mechRefl : (0 A : Type 0) -> (0 x : A) -> MechEq A x x :=
  fun (0 A : Type 0) (0 x : A) => mechReflCtor

def mechJ : (0 A : Type 0) -> (0 x : A) ->
    (0 P : (0 y : A) -> (0 e : MechEq A x y) -> Type 0) ->
    P x (mechRefl A x) -> (0 y : A) -> (e : MechEq A x y) -> P y e :=
  fun (0 A : Type 0) (0 x : A)
    (0 P : (0 y : A) -> (0 e : MechEq A x y) -> Type 0)
    (reflCase : P x (mechRefl A x)) (0 y : A) (e : MechEq A x y) =>
      case e as self in MechEq right return P right self with
      | mechReflCtor => reflCase

def mechTransport : (0 A : Type 0) -> (0 B : A -> Type 0) ->
    (0 x : A) -> (0 y : A) -> MechEq A x y -> B x -> B y :=
  fun (0 A : Type 0) (0 B : A -> Type 0)
    (0 x : A) (0 y : A) (e : MechEq A x y) (value : B x) =>
      mechJ A x (fun (0 right : A) (0 proof : MechEq A x right) => B right)
        value y e

def mechSymm : (0 A : Type 0) -> (0 x : A) -> (0 y : A) ->
    MechEq A x y -> MechEq A y x :=
  fun (0 A : Type 0) (0 x : A) (0 y : A) (e : MechEq A x y) =>
    case e as self in MechEq right return MechEq A right x with
    | mechReflCtor => mechRefl A x

    MechEq A x y -> MechEq A y z -> MechEq A x z :=
  fun (0 A : Type 0) (0 x : A) (0 y : A) (0 z : A)
    (first : MechEq A x y) (second : MechEq A y z) =>
      case second as self in MechEq right return MechEq A x right with
      | mechReflCtor => first

def mechCongr : (0 A : Type 0) -> (0 B : Type 0) -> (0 f : A -> B) ->
    (0 x : A) -> (0 y : A) -> MechEq A x y -> MechEq B (f x) (f y) :=
  fun (0 A : Type 0) (0 B : Type 0) (0 f : A -> B)
    (0 x : A) (0 y : A) (e : MechEq A x y) =>
      case e as self in MechEq right return MechEq B (f x) (f right) with

-- remains an example whose elimination into data is rejected.
mu MechProofEq (0 A : Prop) : (0 x : A) -> (0 y : A) -> Prop with

def mechProofRefl : (0 A : Prop) -> (x : A) -> MechProofEq A x x :=
  fun (0 A : Prop) (x : A) => mechProofReflCtor x

    (0 P : (0 x : A) -> (0 y : A) -> (0 e : MechProofEq A x y) -> Prop) ->
    ((x : A) -> P x x (mechProofRefl A x)) ->

              (Middle_comp D d (F.1 x) (F.1 y) (F.1 z)

            (Target_comp E e (G.1 (F.1 x)) (G.1 (F.1 y)) (G.1 (F.1 z))

def vcompLaw : (0 D : Sort (succ w)) -> (d : Base_Target_Category D) ->
    (0 fx : D) -> (0 fy : D) -> (0 gx : D) -> (0 gy : D) -> (0 hx : D) -> (0 hy : D) ->

    (0 ax : Base_Target_Hom D d fx gx) -> (0 ay : Base_Target_Hom D d fy gy) ->
    (0 bx : Base_Target_Hom D d gx hx) -> (0 by : Base_Target_Hom D d gy hy) ->
    Base_Target (Base_Target_Hom D d fx gy) (Base_Target_comp D d fx fy gy fm ay) (Base_Target_comp D d fx gx gy ax gm) ->
    Base_Target (Base_Target_Hom D d gx hy) (Base_Target_comp D d gx gy hy gm by) (Base_Target_comp D d gx hx hy bx hm) ->
    Base_Target (Base_Target_Hom D d fx hy)
      (Base_Target_comp D d fx fy hy fm (Base_Target_comp D d fy gy hy ay by))
      (Base_Target_comp D d fx hx hy (Base_Target_comp D d fx gx hx ax bx) hm) :=
  fun (0 D : Sort (succ w)) (d : Base_Target_Category D)
      (0 fx : D) (0 fy : D) (0 gx : D) (0 gy : D) (0 hx : D) (0 hy : D)
      (0 fm : Base_Target_Hom D d fx fy) (0 gm : Base_Target_Hom D d gx gy) (0 hm : Base_Target_Hom D d hx hy)
      (0 ax : Base_Target_Hom D d fx gx) (0 ay : Base_Target_Hom D d fy gy)
      (0 bx : Base_Target_Hom D d gx hx) (0 by : Base_Target_Hom D d gy hy)
      (first : Base_Target (Base_Target_Hom D d fx gy)
        (Base_Target_comp D d fx fy gy fm ay) (Base_Target_comp D d fx gx gy ax gm))
      (second : Base_Target (Base_Target_Hom D d gx hy)
        (Base_Target_comp D d gx gy hy gm by) (Base_Target_comp D d gx hx hy bx hm)) =>
    Base_Target_eqTrans (Base_Target_Hom D d fx hy)
      (Base_Target_comp D d fx fy hy fm (Base_Target_comp D d fy gy hy ay by))
      (Base_Target_comp D d fx gy hy (Base_Target_comp D d fx fy gy fm ay) by)
      (Base_Target_comp D d fx hx hy (Base_Target_comp D d fx gx hx ax bx) hm)
      (targetEqSymm (Base_Target_Hom D d fx hy)
        (Base_Target_comp D d fx gy hy (Base_Target_comp D d fx fy gy fm ay) by)
        (Base_Target_comp D d fx fy hy fm (Base_Target_comp D d fy gy hy ay by))
        (Base_Target_assoc D d fx fy gy hy fm ay by))
      (Base_Target_eqTrans (Base_Target_Hom D d fx hy)
        (Base_Target_comp D d fx gy hy (Base_Target_comp D d fx fy gy fm ay) by)
        (Base_Target_comp D d fx gy hy (Base_Target_comp D d fx gx gy ax gm) by)
        (Base_Target_comp D d fx hx hy (Base_Target_comp D d fx gx hx ax bx) hm)
        (Base_Target_eqCongr (Base_Target_Hom D d fx gy) (Base_Target_Hom D d fx hy)
          (fun (h : Base_Target_Hom D d fx gy) => Base_Target_comp D d fx gy hy h by)
          (Base_Target_comp D d fx fy gy fm ay) (Base_Target_comp D d fx gx gy ax gm) first)
        (Base_Target_eqTrans (Base_Target_Hom D d fx hy)
          (Base_Target_comp D d fx gy hy (Base_Target_comp D d fx gx gy ax gm) by)
          (Base_Target_comp D d fx gx hy ax (Base_Target_comp D d gx gy hy gm by))
          (Base_Target_comp D d fx hx hy (Base_Target_comp D d fx gx hx ax bx) hm)
          (Base_Target_assoc D d fx gx gy hy ax gm by)
          (Base_Target_eqTrans (Base_Target_Hom D d fx hy)
            (Base_Target_comp D d fx gx hy ax (Base_Target_comp D d gx gy hy gm by))
            (Base_Target_comp D d fx gx hy ax (Base_Target_comp D d gx hx hy bx hm))
            (Base_Target_comp D d fx hx hy (Base_Target_comp D d fx gx hx ax bx) hm)
            (Base_Target_eqCongr (Base_Target_Hom D d gx hy) (Base_Target_Hom D d fx hy)
              (fun (h : Base_Target_Hom D d gx hy) => Base_Target_comp D d fx gx hy ax h)
              (Base_Target_comp D d gx gy hy gm by) (Base_Target_comp D d gx hx hy bx hm) second)
            (targetEqSymm (Base_Target_Hom D d fx hy)
              (Base_Target_comp D d fx hx hy (Base_Target_comp D d fx gx hx ax bx) hm)
              (Base_Target_comp D d fx gx hy ax (Base_Target_comp D d gx hx hy bx hm))
              (Base_Target_assoc D d fx gx hx hy ax bx hm)))))

-- Vertical composition applies alpha first, then beta.
def vcomp : (0 C : Sort (succ u)) -> (0 D : Sort (succ w)) ->
    (c : Base_Source_Category C) -> (d : Base_Target_Category D) ->
    (F : Base_Functor C D c d) -> (G : Base_Functor C D c d) ->
    (H : Base_Functor C D c d) -> NatTrans C D c d F G ->
    NatTrans C D c d G H -> NatTrans C D c d F H :=
  fun (0 C : Sort (succ u)) (0 D : Sort (succ w))
      (c : Base_Source_Category C) (d : Base_Target_Category D)
      (F : Base_Functor C D c d) (G : Base_Functor C D c d) (H : Base_Functor C D c d)
      (alpha : NatTrans C D c d F G) (beta : NatTrans C D c d G H) =>
    ((fun (x : C) =>
       Base_Target_comp D d (F.1 x) (G.1 x) (H.1 x) (alpha.1 x) (beta.1 x)),
     (fun (0 x : C) (0 y : C) (f : Base_Source_Hom C c x y) =>
       vcompLaw D d (F.1 x) (F.1 y) (G.1 x) (G.1 y) (H.1 x) (H.1 y)
         (Base_functorMap C D c d F x y f) (Base_functorMap C D c d G x y f)
         (Base_functorMap C D c d H x y f) (alpha.1 x) (alpha.1 y) (beta.1 x) (beta.1 y)
         (naturality C D c d F G alpha x y f) (naturality C D c d G H beta x y f)))
end

-- Precomposition evaluates a second-edge component at K's object.
def whiskerRight : (0 C : Sort (succ u)) -> (0 D : Sort (succ w)) ->
    (0 E : Sort (succ p)) -> (c : Base_Source_Category C) ->
    (d : Base_Middle_Category D) -> (e : Base_Target_Category E) ->
    (F : Base_Second_Functor D E d e) -> (G : Base_Second_Functor D E d e) ->
    Second_NatTrans D E d e F G -> (K : Base_First_Functor C D c d) ->
    Composite_NatTrans C E c e
      (Base_compFunctor C D E c d e K F) (Base_compFunctor C D E c d e K G) :=
  fun (0 C : Sort (succ u)) (0 D : Sort (succ w)) (0 E : Sort (succ p))
      (c : Base_Source_Category C) (d : Base_Middle_Category D) (e : Base_Target_Category E)
      (F : Base_Second_Functor D E d e) (G : Base_Second_Functor D E d e)
      (alpha : Second_NatTrans D E d e F G) (K : Base_First_Functor C D c d) =>
    ((fun (x : C) => alpha.1 (K.1 x)),
     (fun (0 x : C) (0 y : C) (f : Base_Source_Hom C c x y) =>
       Second_naturality D E d e F G alpha (K.1 x) (K.1 y)
         (Base_First_functorMap C D c d K x y f)))

-- Postcomposition maps a first-edge component through H.
-- Its proof crosses the Middle/Target equality boundary by congruence.
def whiskerLeft : (0 C : Sort (succ u)) -> (0 D : Sort (succ w)) ->
    (0 E : Sort (succ p)) -> (c : Base_Source_Category C) ->
    (d : Base_Middle_Category D) -> (e : Base_Target_Category E) ->
    (H : Base_Second_Functor D E d e) ->
    (F : Base_First_Functor C D c d) -> (G : Base_First_Functor C D c d) ->
    First_NatTrans C D c d F G ->
    Composite_NatTrans C E c e
      (Base_compFunctor C D E c d e F H) (Base_compFunctor C D E c d e G H) :=
  fun (0 C : Sort (succ u)) (0 D : Sort (succ w)) (0 E : Sort (succ p))
      (c : Base_Source_Category C) (d : Base_Middle_Category D) (e : Base_Target_Category E)
      (H : Base_Second_Functor D E d e)
      (F : Base_First_Functor C D c d) (G : Base_First_Functor C D c d)
      (alpha : First_NatTrans C D c d F G) =>
    ((fun (x : C) => Base_Second_functorMap D E d e H (F.1 x) (G.1 x) (alpha.1 x)),
     (fun (0 x : C) (0 y : C) (f : Base_Source_Hom C c x y) =>
       Base_Target_eqTrans (Base_Target_Hom E e (H.1 (F.1 x)) (H.1 (G.1 y)))
         (Base_Target_comp E e (H.1 (F.1 x)) (H.1 (F.1 y)) (H.1 (G.1 y))
           (Base_Second_functorMap D E d e H (F.1 x) (F.1 y) (Base_First_functorMap C D c d F x y f))
           (Base_Second_functorMap D E d e H (F.1 y) (G.1 y) (alpha.1 y)))
         (Base_Second_functorMap D E d e H (F.1 x) (G.1 y)
           (Base_Middle_comp D d (F.1 x) (F.1 y) (G.1 y)
             (Base_First_functorMap C D c d F x y f) (alpha.1 y)))
         (Base_Target_comp E e (H.1 (F.1 x)) (H.1 (G.1 x)) (H.1 (G.1 y))
           (Base_Second_functorMap D E d e H (F.1 x) (G.1 x) (alpha.1 x))
           (Base_Second_functorMap D E d e H (G.1 x) (G.1 y) (Base_First_functorMap C D c d G x y f)))
         (targetEqSymm (Base_Target_Hom E e (H.1 (F.1 x)) (H.1 (G.1 y)))
           (Base_Second_functorMap D E d e H (F.1 x) (G.1 y)
             (Base_Middle_comp D d (F.1 x) (F.1 y) (G.1 y)
               (Base_First_functorMap C D c d F x y f) (alpha.1 y)))
           (Base_Target_comp E e (H.1 (F.1 x)) (H.1 (F.1 y)) (H.1 (G.1 y))
             (Base_Second_functorMap D E d e H (F.1 x) (F.1 y) (Base_First_functorMap C D c d F x y f))
             (Base_Second_functorMap D E d e H (F.1 y) (G.1 y) (alpha.1 y)))
           (Base_Second_functorMapComp D E d e H (F.1 x) (F.1 y) (G.1 y)
             (Base_First_functorMap C D c d F x y f) (alpha.1 y)))
         (Base_Target_eqTrans (Base_Target_Hom E e (H.1 (F.1 x)) (H.1 (G.1 y)))
           (Base_Second_functorMap D E d e H (F.1 x) (G.1 y)
             (Base_Middle_comp D d (F.1 x) (F.1 y) (G.1 y)
               (Base_First_functorMap C D c d F x y f) (alpha.1 y)))
           (Base_Second_functorMap D E d e H (F.1 x) (G.1 y)
             (Base_Middle_comp D d (F.1 x) (G.1 x) (G.1 y)
               (alpha.1 x) (Base_First_functorMap C D c d G x y f)))
           (Base_Target_comp E e (H.1 (F.1 x)) (H.1 (G.1 x)) (H.1 (G.1 y))
             (Base_Second_functorMap D E d e H (F.1 x) (G.1 x) (alpha.1 x))
             (Base_Second_functorMap D E d e H (G.1 x) (G.1 y) (Base_First_functorMap C D c d G x y f)))
           (Base_Second_eqCongr (Base_Middle_Hom D d (F.1 x) (G.1 y))
             (Base_Target_Hom E e (H.1 (F.1 x)) (H.1 (G.1 y)))
             (fun (h : Base_Middle_Hom D d (F.1 x) (G.1 y)) =>
               Base_Second_functorMap D E d e H (F.1 x) (G.1 y) h)
             (Base_Middle_comp D d (F.1 x) (F.1 y) (G.1 y)
               (Base_First_functorMap C D c d F x y f) (alpha.1 y))
             (Base_Middle_comp D d (F.1 x) (G.1 x) (G.1 y)
               (alpha.1 x) (Base_First_functorMap C D c d G x y f))
             (First_naturality C D c d F G alpha x y f))
           (Base_Second_functorMapComp D E d e H (F.1 x) (G.1 x) (G.1 y)
             (alpha.1 x) (Base_First_functorMap C D c d G x y f)))))
end
